items.title: 印度政府折價10%出售人壽保險龍頭持股 拚募33億美元
items.title_en: Indian Government Sells Life Insurance Giant Stake at 10% Discount, Aiming to Raise $3.3 Billion
paras: 印度政府宣布，將出售國營印度人壽保險公司 (Life Insurance Corporation of India，LIC) 最多 6.5% 股權，售股價格較周一收盤價折價約 10%，預計最高可募得 3140 億盧比(約 33 億美元)，以推動國營企業釋股計畫，並符合監管機關對最低公眾持股比率的要求。
根據 LIC 周一提交至印度證券交易所的公告，本次公開出售 (Offer for Sale，OFS) 基本規模為出售 2.5% 股權，另設有額外出售 4% 股權的選擇權，若全數出售，政府最高可募得 3140 億盧比(約 33 億美元)。
此次售股價格訂為每股 382 盧比，公開申購將於周二開始、周三截止。
目前印度政府仍持有 LIC 約 96.5% 股權，依照監管規定，須於 2032 年前將持股降至 75%，以符合最低公眾持股比率 (Minimum Public Shareholding) 要求，因此未來仍須持續出售部分持股。
LIC 是印度最大的壽險公司，依保費收入計算，市占率超過 56%。截至 2026 年 3 月底，該公司管理資產規模 (AUM) 達 57.29 兆盧比，約合 6000 億美元，在印度金融市場占有舉足輕重地位。
印度政府早在 2022 年便透過首次公開發行 (IPO) 出售 LIC 3.5% 股權，當時募資逾 27 億美元，為當時印度資本市場規模最大的 IPO 之一。
股價表現方面，今年以來，印度 Nifty 50 指數累計下跌 5.25%，LIC 股價則僅小跌約 0.5%，相對大盤展現較佳抗跌能力。
除了 LIC 之外，印度政府今年稍早也陸續出售多家國營企業持股，包括 Cochin Shipyard、Indian Railways Finance Corp、NHPC 及 Coal India 等公司，根據印度財政部統計，相關釋股合計募得 2100 億盧比 (約 22 億美元)。
市場分析指出，印度政府近年的國企釋股多採折價發行方式，以提升市場承接意願、消化較大量股票供給，同時確保政府減持計畫順利完成。此次 LIC 以較收盤價折價約 10% 出售股份，也延續印度政府近年推動國營企業改革與擴大市場流通股比重的一貫策略。
paras_en: The Indian government announced it will sell up to 6.5% of the state‑owned Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) at a price roughly 10% below Monday’s closing price, potentially raising as much as 314 billion rupees (about $33 billion) to advance its state‑owned‑enterprise divestment plan and meet regulator‑mandated minimum public shareholding requirements.

According to a notice LIC filed with the Indian stock exchange on Monday, the Offer for Sale (OFS) will initially comprise a 2.5% stake, with an additional optional 4% tranche. If the full 6.5% is sold, the government could raise up to 314 billion rupees (about $33 billion).
The sale price is set at 382 rupees per share, with the public subscription opening on Tuesday and closing on Wednesday.

The government currently holds about 96.5% of LIC and, under regulatory rules, must reduce its holding to 75% by 2032 to satisfy the Minimum Public Shareholding requirement, meaning further disposals will be needed in the future.

LIC is India’s largest life insurer, commanding over 56% market share by premium income. As of the end of March 2026, the company’s assets under management totalled 57.29 trillion rupees, roughly $600 billion, giving it a pivotal role in India’s financial markets.
The government first sold a 3.5% stake in LIC via an IPO in 2022, raising more than $2.7 billion – one of the biggest IPOs in the Indian capital market at the time.
In terms of stock performance, the Nifty 50 index has fallen 5.25% year‑to‑date, while LIC’s share price has slipped only about 0.5%, showing relative resilience against the broader market.

Beyond LIC, the government earlier this year has been divesting stakes in several state‑owned firms, including Cochin Shipyard, Indian Railways Finance Corp, NHPC and Coal India. According to the finance ministry, those disposals have collectively raised 210 billion rupees (about $22 billion).

Analysts note that the Indian government has recently favored discounted offerings for state‑owned‑enterprise share sales to boost market appetite and absorb large share supplies, while ensuring the divestment roadmap stays on track. The roughly 10% discount on LIC shares continues this strategy of reforming state‑owned enterprises and increasing the proportion of freely tradable stock.

items.title: 華府智庫CSIS：川普屢次未兌現打擊威脅 讓伊朗認為美國很軟弱
items.title_en: CSIS: Trump's Repeated Failure to Follow Through on Threats Makes Iran See the U.S. as Weak
paras: 美國智庫「戰略與國際問題研究中心 (CSIS)」中東項目主任 Mona Yacoubian 周一(3 日) 警告，川普政府多次對伊朗放出「最嚴厲威脅」卻未在最後關頭兌現打擊行動，已讓德黑蘭解讀為「美國軟弱」，並自認在美伊衝突中佔據上風。
她說：「每次他這樣做，伊朗接收到的訊號就是：美國很軟弱，伊朗佔了上風。」
Yacoubian 也整理出當前的「軍事升級→宣布外交突破卻落空→重回相互威脅」的循環模式。
她認為，這種「狼來了」式的操作削弱華府威懾可信度，也讓伊朗更有底氣拖過選舉週期與彈藥消耗期。
Yacoubian 還指出，美國最近一次暫緩打擊，關鍵變數在波斯灣盟友——沙特、阿聯、卡達擔心伊朗會毫不猶豫報復區域基礎設施與能源樞紐，把霍爾木茲風險一次性引爆，因此向白宮施壓踩剎車。
分析指出，特朗普「極限施壓＋臨陣回縮」的談判術，用於商業博弈或尚可，但面對承受痛苦門檻更高的伊朗政體，反襯出華府軍事選項的政治成本：中期選舉將近、油價敏感、彈藥庫存下滑。伊朗則借機把「美國不敢打」內化為心理優勢，在核談判、海峽通行與代理人戰線上同步抬價。
市場與外交圈解讀，若威懾可信度持續流失，下階段風險不在「美國打多大」，而在「伊朗先手多狠」——從無人機騷擾到能源設施靶向攻擊，區域火藥味只會更濃。
paras_en: Mona Yacoubian, director of the Middle East program at the U.S. think tank Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS), warned on Monday (the 3rd) that the Trump administration’s repeated issuance of "the harshest threats" toward Iran without actually carrying out strikes at the last moment has led Tehran to interpret this as "U.S. weakness" and to believe it holds the upper hand in any U.S.-Iran confrontation.
She said, "Every time he does this, the signal Iran receives is: the United States is weak, and Iran has the advantage."
Yacoubian also outlined the current cycle of "military escalation → announced diplomatic breakthrough that falls flat → back to mutual threats."
She believes this "boy‑who‑cried‑wolf" approach erodes the credibility of Washington’s deterrence and gives Iran more confidence to ride out an election cycle and a period of ammunition consumption.

Yacoubian further noted that the most recent U.S. pause on strikes was driven by concerns from Gulf allies—Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Qatar—that Iran might retaliate without hesitation against regional infrastructure and energy hubs, potentially igniting a one‑off crisis in the Strait of Hormuz, prompting them to pressure the White House to hit the brakes.

Analysts say Trump’s “maximum pressure plus last‑minute retreat” negotiating style might work in commercial games, but against an Iranian regime with a higher pain threshold it highlights the political cost of U.S. military options: a looming midterm election, oil‑price sensitivity, and dwindling ammunition stockpiles. Iran, meanwhile, is turning the perception that "the U.S. won’t dare to strike" into a psychological advantage, raising its demands simultaneously in nuclear talks, Strait navigation and proxy‑war fronts.

Market observers and diplomats interpret that if deterrence credibility continues to erode, the next risk is not how big a U.S. strike could be, but how aggressively Iran might act first—ranging from drone harassment to targeted attacks on energy facilities—making the regional powder keg even more volatile.

items.title: 長聖CDMO與新藥開發雙引擎發酵 7月營收9925萬元創高
items.title_en: Changsheng CDMO and New Drug Development Dual Engines Ferment, July Revenue Reaches NT$99.25 Million
paras: 長聖 (6712-TW) 公告 7 月營收 9925 萬元，年月雙成長，其中年增超過 2 成。長聖指出，受惠再生醫療與細胞治療市場需求升溫，帶動 CDMO 業務穩定放量，「CDMO + 新藥研發」雙引擎策略持續發酵。
長聖 7 月營收 9925 萬元，月增 5.72%，年增 20.72%；累計今年前 7 月營收 5.59 億元，年增 16.31%。
長聖表示，旗下自主研發的異體、現貨型 (Off-the-shelf)CAR-T 細胞治療新藥 CA002，完成美國與台灣核准的一期劑量遞增試驗，展現良好安全性、未觀察到劑量限制性毒性 (DLT)，順利通過安全性監測委員會 (SMC) 審查，正式邁入臨床 2a 療效驗證階段，也完成首位受試者收治。
長聖指出，有鑑於 GBM(膠質母細胞瘤) 為成人常見且侵襲性高的原發性惡性腫瘤、臨床預後差，長聖已啟動 CAR001 針對 GBM 適應症的美國 FDA 孤兒藥資格 (ODD) 申請規劃。若順利取得，將可獲得法規審查加速、賦稅優惠及市場獨占期等優勢，強化國際臨床開發、國際授權合作及多中心臨床的競爭力。
展望後市，董事長劉銖淇將持續推進 CAR001 臨床開發、國際法規布局與全球授權合作，並結合 CDMO 事業，打造「CDMO + 創新細胞治療」雙引擎發展策略。
paras_en: Changsheng (6712-TW) announced its July revenue of NT$99.25 million, with double-digit growth year-over-year and month-over-month. The company attributed this to the rising demand in the regenerative medicine and cell therapy markets, which drove the stable growth of its CDMO business. The 'CDMO + new drug development' dual-engine strategy continues to ferment.

Changsheng's July revenue was NT$99.25 million, up 5.72% month-over-month and 20.72% year-over-year. The cumulative revenue for the first seven months of the year was NT$559 million, up 16.31% year-over-year.

Changsheng stated that its self-developed allogeneic, off-the-shelf CAR-T cell therapy new drug CA002 has completed the Phase 1 dose-escalation trial in the US and Taiwan, demonstrating good safety and no dose-limiting toxicity (DLT). It has passed the safety monitoring committee (SMC) review and officially entered the Phase 2a efficacy verification stage, with the first patient enrolled.

Changsheng noted that due to glioblastoma (GBM) being a common and aggressive primary malignant tumor in adults with poor clinical prognosis, the company has initiated the planning for the US FDA orphan drug designation (ODD) application for CAR001 targeting GBM. If successful, it will gain advantages such as accelerated regulatory review, tax incentives, and market exclusivity, enhancing its international clinical development, licensing cooperation, and multi-center clinical trial competitiveness.

Looking ahead, Chairman Liu Chunqi will continue to push forward the clinical development of CAR001, international regulatory layout, and global licensing cooperation, while combining the CDMO business to build a 'CDMO + innovative cell therapy' dual-engine development strategy.

items.title: 三星晶圓代工產能利用率衝100% 最快Q3轉虧為盈
items.title_en: Samsung Foundry Sees 100% Utilization Rate in Q3, Turning Loss to Profit
paras: 在人工智慧（AI）與高頻寬記憶體（HBM）需求的強勁驅動下，三星電子 (005930KS) 晶圓代工下半年的產能利用率有望衝刺 100%，意味著困擾公司逾一年的慢性虧損結構，即將迎來歷史性的轉捩點。
根據韓媒《朝鮮日報》報導，三星晶圓代工目前的產能利用率已處於 70% 至 80% 的區間，結合現有的訂單積壓與各項合約推進進度，年內實現滿產幾乎已成定局。
三星電子在二季度的業績說明會中指出，各製程節點的利用率均較去年同期出現顯著改善，特別是 8 奈米以下的先進製程已達到最高水準，預計今年的 2 奈米項目訂單量將較去年翻倍成長。
儘管公司對於扭虧的確切時點保持審慎，但公開表示該目標在不久的將來即可實現。
市場分析人士普遍樂觀預期，隨著產能利用率回歸常態，加上晶圓價格上漲的有利因素，晶圓代工與系統 LSI 等非存儲業務最快將於第 3 季度、最遲第 4 季度實現轉虧為盈，其獲利改善的速度或將超越市場原本預期。
此波產能利用率的回升，核心動力主要來自兩大主線。首先是第六代高頻寬記憶體（HBM4）採用 4 奈米製程，成功將記憶體市場的景氣週期向晶圓代工業務傳導。
其次，雲端服務供應商（CSP）及人工智慧（AI）、高性能計算（HPC）客戶對於 2 奈米製程的需求持續攀升，包括博通 (AVGO-US) 等國際指標性客戶的項目洽談皆在推進中。
由於半導體代工行業設備投資巨大，屬於典型的高固定成本產業，過去一年因利用率長期低於 50% 導致的嚴重虧損，有望隨著利用率回歸正軌，將新增營收直接轉化為獲利貢獻。
在客戶結構的拓展上，三星晶圓代工正積極擺脫過度依賴單一大客戶的現狀，高通 (QCOM-US) 、AMD(AMD-US) 、谷歌 (GOOGL-US) 等科技巨頭已陸續加入合作洽談，特斯拉(TSLA-US) 據傳也計劃將下一代晶片交由其 2 奈米製程生產，中長期訂單管線顯著增厚。
然而，業界人士強調，要真正拿下高通等巨頭的大規模量產訂單，跨越 2 奈米製程 70% 的良率「生死線」才是決勝關鍵。目前該製程良率約在 60% 區間，仍有進一步提升空間。
綜論所述，三星晶圓代工的業務結構正在進行深層調整，預計今年先進製程的營收佔比將突破 50%，而人工智慧及高性能計算相關業務佔比也將大幅躍升至 30% 以上。
配合美國德州 Taylor 一廠的投產準備，以及二廠的啟動計畫，三星正同步推動產能擴張。
市場分析認為，100% 的產能利用率是業務終結虧損的啟動訊號，但唯有實現 2 奈米良率的穩定突破，才能真正確立三星在先進製程領域的競爭地位，並讓大型客戶的旗艦產品委託代工成為業務重塑的堅實基礎。
paras_en: Driven by strong demand for artificial intelligence (AI) and high-bandwidth memory (HBM), Samsung Electronics' (005930KS) foundry business is expected to reach a 100% utilization rate in the second half of the year, marking a historic turning point for the company's chronic loss structure.

According to a report by the Korean media outlet Chosun Ilbo, Samsung's foundry business currently has a utilization rate of 70-80%, and with existing orders and contract progress, achieving full capacity utilization is almost a certainty for the year.

At its second-quarter earnings briefing, Samsung Electronics noted that utilization rates for all process nodes had improved significantly compared to the same period last year, with advanced processes below 8 nanometers reaching their highest levels. The company expects 2-nanometer orders to grow by more than double year-over-year.
Although the company remains cautious about the exact timing of its goal to turn losses into profits, it has publicly stated that it expects to achieve this goal in the near future.

Market analysts are generally optimistic, expecting that with utilization rates returning to normal and rising memory prices, Samsung's foundry business and system LSI will turn losses into profits as early as the third quarter or at the latest the fourth quarter, with profit improvement potentially exceeding market expectations.

The current surge in utilization rates is driven by two major factors. First, the adoption of 4-nanometer process for the sixth-generation high-bandwidth memory (HBM4) has successfully transmitted the memory market's cyclical trend to the foundry business.

Second, cloud service providers (CSPs) and AI, HPC customers continue to drive demand for 2-nanometer processes, including high-profile customers such as Broadcom (AVGO-US) and Qualcomm (QCOM-US), with project discussions ongoing.

Due to the massive equipment investment in the semiconductor foundry industry, which is a typical high-fixed-cost industry, the severe losses caused by low utilization rates below 50% for the past year are expected to be reversed as utilization rates return to normal, converting additional revenue directly into profit contributions.

In terms of customer structure expansion, Samsung's foundry business is actively working to break away from its over-reliance on a single large customer, with high-profile tech giants such as Google (GOOGL-US), AMD (AMD-US), and Tesla (TSLA-US) joining the fray, with a significant increase in the mid-to-long-term order pipeline.
However, industry insiders emphasize that crossing the '70% yield line' for the 2-nanometer process is the key to securing large-scale production orders from high-profile customers like Qualcomm.
Currently, the 2-nanometer process yield is around 60%, leaving room for further improvement.

In summary, Samsung's foundry business is undergoing a deep structural adjustment, with advanced process revenue expected to exceed 50% of total revenue this year, and AI and HPC-related business expected to jump to over 30%.
In conjunction with the preparation for the Taylor factory in Texas and the startup plan for the second factory, Samsung is simultaneously driving capacity expansion.

Market analysis believes that a 100% utilization rate is a signal to end losses, but only by achieving stable breakthroughs in 2-nanometer yields can Samsung establish a competitive position in the advanced process field and secure flagship product orders from large customers as a solid foundation for business restructuring.

items.title: 美軍已經沒招？伊朗否認與美談判、稱川普是「第十次」TACO
items.title_en: Iran Denies Talks with US, Calls Trump's Threats 'Taco 10'
paras: 伊朗外交部發言人巴加埃週一（3 日）在例行記者會上駁斥美國總統川普稍早的說法，強調德黑蘭目前並未與華盛頓進行任何形式的談判，近期也沒有接待或派遣代表團的計畫。同時，伊媒也指出，這已經是川普第十次在對德黑蘭的「決定性」軍事威脅面前退縮，恐削弱美國威懾力。
巴加埃並澄清，外長阿拉格齊當天是前往參與朝聖活動，並非赴外會談，伊朗所有談判人員仍留在國內。
巴加埃指出，伊朗目前在進行的對話對象是阿曼，議題聚焦於荷姆茲海峽的航行安全，雙方希望儘速就一條臨時安全航道達成共識，讓船隻得以恢復通行。
他強調，這純粹是伊朗與阿曼之間的雙邊事務，其他國家或勢力介入與否，都不會改變這項談判的性質。
至於外界關注的海峽現狀，巴加埃警告，只要美方持續採取挑釁行動並維持海上封鎖，情勢就難有實質改變。
根據伊朗《法爾斯通訊社》報導，就在同一天，伊朗革命衛隊宣布在荷姆茲海峽上空擊落一架美製 MQ-9 無人機。
這場外交羅生門的背景，是川普週六（1 日）的公開表態。他當時宣稱已取消原訂的大規模軍事打擊計畫，改為爭取儘快與伊朗達成協議，藉此化解核武疑慮並重新打通荷姆茲海峽的航運。
然而，《CNN》3 日獨家引述消息人士指出，美軍中央司令部一名情報官員上週三透過電子郵件，向軍事分析師徵詢對伊朗施壓與懲罰的「新穎且非傳統」構想，顯示五角大廈內部正在就下一步行動集思廣益。
消息人士形容，這種以電子郵件公開徵求意見的作法相當罕見，某種程度反映出川普政府想在其開出的條件下迫使伊朗讓步，但可用選項其實相當有限。
中央司令部發言人霍金斯回應時則將此舉定調為單位一貫的創新文化，稱司令庫珀向來樂於傾聽團隊中各階層成員的意見，以追求最佳作戰成效。
報導並提到，川普陣營內部也在評估升高軍事行動的可能性，包括是否重啟對伊朗殘餘核設施的打擊。但消息人士坦言，由於相關設施深埋地下，單靠飛彈與炸彈恐怕難以造成決定性破壞。
另一個選項則是象徵性較強、規模有限的「表演式」打擊，鎖定過去曾攻擊過的類似目標，讓川普得以宣稱勝利並藉機收手，而不必真正達成徹底清除伊朗核計畫的原始目標。
報導同時指出，無論採取何種軍事手段，恐怕都無法解決衝突核心，即伊朗對荷姆茲海峽的實質掌控權。
消息人士指出：「追根究底，總統（川普）還是想達成協議的，所以他會不斷尋找強硬應對並從中脫身的方法。有時候你需要富有創造力的頭腦，尤其是在常規選項即將耗盡的時候。」
《華爾街日報》3 日的分析則認為，川普在連日威脅對伊朗發動新一輪攻勢後，如今又轉向外交手段，顯示他仍希望以談判取得軍事行動未能完成的目標。
報導認為，關鍵在於美國的波灣盟友能否在短時間內取得實質進展，至少讓荷姆茲海峽恢復部分通航，為後續核談判鋪路；但若協商再度陷入僵局，川普可能重演過去的模式，先擱置軍事威脅，再伺機重新祭出。
伊朗《邁赫爾通訊社》則以較強硬的語氣評論指出，這已是川普第十次在對德黑蘭祭出「決定性」軍事威脅後選擇退讓，認為美方一再的猶豫不僅削弱了自身的威懾力，也讓區域內盟友與對手重新評估各方真實的實力對比。
分析指出，伊朗議題如今已不只是外交層面的角力，更牽動川普的內政與戰略處境，若持續維持現行策略而不做調整，恐讓白宮陷入更難脫身的困境。
paras_en: Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson, Bahram Ghasemi, rejected US President Donald Trump's claims of negotiations between the two countries, stating that Tehran is not engaged in any form of talks with Washington. He also denied reports of a planned meeting between the two sides.

Ghasemi clarified that Foreign Minister Mohammad Javad Zarif was in the country for a pilgrimage and not for a meeting with the US. He emphasized that all Iranian negotiators are still in the country.

Ghasemi stated that Iran is currently engaged in talks with Oman, focusing on the safety of navigation in the Hormuz Strait. The two sides aim to reach an agreement on a temporary safety corridor as soon as possible, allowing ships to resume passage.
He stressed that this is a bilateral issue between Iran and Oman, and that the nature of the talks will not be changed by the involvement of other countries or powers.
Regarding the current situation in the strait, Ghasemi warned that as long as the US continues to take provocative actions and maintains a naval blockade, the situation will not improve.
According to a report by Iran's Fars News Agency, the Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps announced that it had shot down a US-made MQ-9 drone in the Hormuz Strait on the same day.

The background to this diplomatic standoff is Trump's public statement on Saturday, in which he claimed to have canceled a planned large-scale military strike and instead sought to reach an agreement with Iran to resolve nuclear concerns and reopen the Hormuz Strait to shipping.

However, a CNN exclusive on Monday quoted sources as saying that a US military intelligence officer had emailed a military analyst on Tuesday, seeking innovative and non-traditional ideas for pressuring and punishing Iran.
The sources described this as an unusual move, reflecting the Trump administration's desire to force Iran to make concessions under its conditions, but with limited options available.

The US Central Command spokesperson, Colonel John Thomas, responded by downplaying the move as a routine part of the unit's innovative culture, saying that Commander Kenneth McKenzie has always encouraged team members to share their ideas to achieve the best possible operational outcomes.

The report also noted that the Trump administration is evaluating the possibility of escalating military action, including restarting attacks on Iran's remaining nuclear facilities. However, sources acknowledged that the facilities are deeply buried underground, making it difficult to achieve a decisive blow with missiles and bombs.

Another option is a symbolic and limited 'showcase' attack targeting similar past targets, allowing Trump to claim victory and withdraw without achieving the original goal of completely eliminating Iran's nuclear program.
The report concluded that any military action would likely fail to address the core issue of Iran's control over the Hormuz Strait.
A source said, 'Ultimately, the president still wants to reach an agreement, so he will continue to look for ways to respond strongly and then get out of it.'
The Wall Street Journal's analysis on Monday noted that Trump's shift from threats to diplomacy shows that he still hopes to achieve his military goals through negotiations.

The report emphasized that the key to success lies in the US's Gulf allies making tangible progress in a short period, at least allowing for partial navigation of the Hormuz Strait and paving the way for future nuclear talks. However, if negotiations stall again, Trump may repeat his past pattern of postponing military threats and waiting for an opportunity to re-deploy them.

Iran's Mehr News Agency took a harder line, stating that this is Trump's tenth time threatening Iran with 'decisive' military action before backing down, and that the US's repeated hesitation has weakened its deterrent power and led regional allies and adversaries to reassess the balance of power.

The analysis concluded that the Iran issue has become more than just a diplomatic standoff, but also involves Trump's domestic and strategic situation. If the US continues to maintain its current strategy without adjustment, it may lead the White House into an even more difficult situation.

items.title: 財經名嘴：華爾街最新「籃子交易」正創造逢低布局機會
items.title_en: CNBC's Jim Cramer: Wall Street's 'Basket Trades' Are Creating Buying Opportunities
paras: 《CNBC》財經節目主持人 Jim Cramer 周一 (3 日) 表示，華爾街近期盛行的「籃子交易(Basket Trades)」正在扭曲許多股票的價格表現，投資人反而可以利用這些錯價尋找布局機會。
Cramer 在節目中談到，「最棒的事？就是這些交易創造了真正的投資機會。在公司公布財報前，股價往往會脫離基本面。」
「當市場以籃子交易形成的估值，遇上真正的財報表現時，就有機會帶來可觀的獲利。」
Cramer 指出，交易員愈來愈傾向依照特定主題將股票歸類成不同「籃子」，使同一類股票同步上漲或下跌，而不是根據各家公司本身的基本面來決定股價。
他表示，這類交易方式尤其在中東衝突持續期間主導每日走勢，但很多時候與企業長期前景並沒有太大關聯。
Cramer 以波音 (Boeing)(BA-US) 為例指出，近期波音股價愈來愈受到中東地緣政治消息影響。當市場看到外交談判取得進展時，波音股價便上漲，若衝突升溫，股價則同步下跌。但他認為，這些每日新聞並不會改變波音長期的投資價值。
Cramer 表示，「真正決定波音價值的，是現金流與飛機生產能力，而不是把波音當成交易工具。」他指出，波音目前握有約 6,200 架飛機的積壓訂單，這遠比中東局勢短期變化更值得投資人關注。

根據 Cramer，零售股近期也成為典型的籃子交易。當中東局勢緊張、油價走高引發市場對通膨的擔憂時，投資人開始轉向好市多 (Costco)(COST-US) 與沃爾瑪 (Walmart)(WMT-US)，因市場認為，在消費者因油價上漲而縮減支出時，這兩家公司將是受惠者，同時賣出 Ralph Lauren(RL-US)、Target(TGT-US) 及 Williams-Sonoma(WSM-US)等偏非必須性消費的零售股。
他表示，「好市多和沃爾瑪都是優秀、能夠長期持有的零售企業。無論戰爭情勢如何，它們都值得投資。」
Cramer 指出，今年上半年，科技股成為華爾街最熱門籃子交易之一。市場普遍追捧 AI 基礎設施相關股票，同時大舉賣出企業軟體公司，而不論各家公司本身的營運表現如何。
他表示，市場普遍認為，AI 熱潮最大的受惠者將是硬體供應商，而企業軟體業者則可能因 AI 衝擊傳統按席位收費模式而面臨壓力。不過，隨著這股交易趨勢開始反轉，基本面較佳的企業開始脫穎而出。ServiceNow(NOW-US) 與 Salesforce(CRM-US) 等公司已逐漸擺脫整體軟體族群同步波動的影響，開始反映自身基本面的價值。
Cramer 坦言，短期內，籃子交易確實可能壓過企業基本面，主導股價走勢。但他認為，每逢財報季，市場最終仍會重新把焦點放回各家公司本身的營運表現。
他談到，「很高興看到基本面終究還是重要的，即使這種情況一年只有四次，在財報季時才會發生。」
paras_en: CNBC's Jim Cramer said on Monday that Wall Street's recent 'basket trades' are distorting the price performance of many stocks, but investors can use these mispricings to find buying opportunities.
Cramer said, 'The best thing is that these trades are creating real investment opportunities. Before companies report their earnings, stock prices tend to diverge from their fundamental value.'
He added, 'When the market's valuation based on basket trades meets the actual earnings performance, it can lead to significant profits.'

Cramer pointed out that traders are increasingly inclined to categorize stocks into different 'baskets' based on specific themes, causing stocks in the same category to move in tandem, rather than being determined by each company's fundamental value.
He noted that this type of trading is particularly prevalent during periods of Middle East conflict, but often has little to do with the long-term prospects of the companies involved.

Cramer used Boeing (BA-US) as an example, saying that the company's stock price has been increasingly influenced by Middle East geopolitical news. When diplomatic talks progress, Boeing's stock price rises, and when tensions escalate, it falls. However, he believes that these daily news events will not change Boeing's long-term investment value.

Cramer said, 'What really determines Boeing's value is its cash flow and aircraft production capacity, not treating Boeing as a trading tool.' He noted that Boeing currently has about 6,200 aircraft on order, which is a much more significant factor for investors to consider than short-term changes in Middle East tensions.

According to Cramer, retail stocks have also become a typical example of basket trading. When Middle East tensions are high and oil prices rise, investors start to shift towards Costco (COST-US) and Walmart (WMT-US), which are seen as beneficiaries in a scenario where consumers reduce spending due to higher oil prices.
He said, 'Costco and Walmart are excellent, long-term retail companies. Regardless of the war situation, they are worth investing in.'

Cramer pointed out that in the first half of this year, tech stocks became one of the most popular basket trades on Wall Street. The market widely chased AI infrastructure-related stocks while selling off enterprise software companies, regardless of their individual operating performance.

He said, 'The market widely believes that the AI trend will benefit hardware suppliers, while enterprise software companies may face pressure due to the disruption of traditional per-seat pricing models.' However, as this trading trend begins to reverse, companies with better fundamentals are starting to emerge.

ServiceNow (NOW-US) and Salesforce (CRM-US) are examples of companies that have gradually escaped the influence of the overall software sector's volatility and are starting to reflect their own fundamental values.

Cramer said, 'In the short term, basket trades may indeed overpower company fundamentals and drive stock prices. However, he believes that every time earnings season comes around, the market will eventually refocus on the operating performance of individual companies.'
He said, 'It's great to see that fundamentals still matter, even if it only happens four times a year during earnings season.'

items.title: 日本本輪救匯狂砸11兆日元 接近歷史最大規模
items.title_en: Japan's Intervention Brings 11 Trillion Yen to Market, Approaching Historic Scale
paras: 本周一（3 日）晚間的消息顯示，根據日本央行的貨幣市場數據推算，上周四、周五的外匯干預中可能又動用了超過等值 11 兆日元的銀彈。
作為背景，日本在 4 月至 5 月期間的那一輪外匯干預中，共動用價值近 11.73 兆日元（約 736 億美元）的資金，創日本干預外匯市場單月規模新高。
日本央行的最新數據顯示，基於上周五政府部門的交易，金融體系將於周二面臨 11.4 兆日元的流動性流出。金融交易通常在兩個工作日後結算。貨幣經紀商此前預期的流出規模約 6 兆日元，多出來的 5 兆很有可能就是日本當局干預匯市的規模。
此前測算顯示，日本當局在上周四可能動用美元購入 6 至 7 兆日元。這意味著這一輪外匯干預很有可能接近甚至超越三個月前的紀錄。
日本財務大臣片山皋月周一早些時候發布聲明，證實日本和美國在上周五聯合干預匯市，以應對日元近期「過度波動和無序走勢」。她表示，將毫不猶豫採取進一步行動。
美國財長貝森特也在社交媒體發帖證實了這一行動，並表示「美國將毫不猶豫參與進一步聯合干預」。
作為本次干預的短線效果，日元匯率從上周四最低時的 1 美元兌 164 日元，到周一早盤時段曾觸及 1 美元兌 155.2 日元。
值得一提的是，在 4 月至 5 月的干預中，日元匯率也一度從 160 快速升至 155 區間。但由於日本貨幣的結構性弱勢（日美利差、油價上漲和美國聯準會升息預期），那一輪砸下 700 多億美元的效果僅維持了一個多月。
考慮到這些打壓日元的因素依然存在，即便美國罕見出手聯合干預日元，日元漲勢能維持多久依然面臨較大不確定性。
paras_en: According to data from the Bank of Japan, the country's currency market intervention on Thursday and Friday may have used more than ¥11 trillion in foreign exchange reserves.

In the context of the previous intervention in April and May, Japan used approximately ¥11.73 trillion (around $736 billion) in funds, setting a new record for the largest monthly intervention in the country's history.

The Bank of Japan's latest data shows that, based on government transactions on Friday, the financial system will face a liquidity outflow of ¥11.4 trillion on Tuesday. Financial transactions are typically settled two business days later.
Currency brokers had previously estimated a liquidity outflow of around ¥6 trillion, with the additional ¥5 trillion likely to be the scale of Japan's intervention in the foreign exchange market.

Previous estimates suggested that Japan may have used ¥6 to ¥7 trillion to purchase US dollars on Thursday, indicating that this round of intervention may be approaching or even surpassing the record set three months ago.

Japanese Finance Minister Shunichi Suzuki released a statement on Monday morning, confirming that Japan and the US had jointly intervened in the foreign exchange market on Friday to address the yen's recent 'excessive volatility and disorderly movement'.
He stated that Japan would take further action without hesitation.
US Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen also confirmed the action on social media, stating that 'the US will participate in further joint intervention without hesitation'.
As a short-term effect of the intervention, the yen's exchange rate rose from a low of 164 yen per dollar on Thursday to a high of 155.2 yen per dollar on Monday morning.

It's worth noting that the yen's exchange rate also rose from 160 to 155 in the previous intervention in April and May, but the effect was short-lived due to Japan's structural currency weakness (yen-dollar interest rate differential, rising oil prices, and expectations of a US Federal Reserve rate hike).
That intervention, which used over $700 billion, only lasted for a month.
Considering that these factors are still in place, even with the rare joint intervention by the US, the sustainability of the yen's rally remains uncertain.

items.title: 長聖CDMO與新藥開發雙引擎發酵 7月營收9925萬元創高
items.title_en: Changsheng CDMO and New Drug Development Dual Engines Ferment, July Revenue Reaches NT$99.25 Million
paras: 長聖 (6712-TW) 公告 7 月營收 9925 萬元，年月雙成長，其中年增超過 2 成。長聖指出，受惠再生醫療與細胞治療市場需求升溫，帶動 CDMO 業務穩定放量，「CDMO + 新藥研發」雙引擎策略持續發酵。
長聖 7 月營收 9925 萬元，月增 5.72%，年增 20.72%；累計今年前 7 月營收 5.59 億元，年增 16.31%。
長聖表示，旗下自主研發的異體、現貨型 (Off-the-shelf)CAR-T 細胞治療新藥 CA002，完成美國與台灣核准的一期劑量遞增試驗，展現良好安全性、未觀察到劑量限制性毒性 (DLT)，順利通過安全性監測委員會 (SMC) 審查，正式邁入臨床 2a 療效驗證階段，也完成首位受試者收治。
長聖指出，有鑑於 GBM(膠質母細胞瘤) 為成人常見且侵襲性高的原發性惡性腫瘤、臨床預後差，長聖已啟動 CAR001 針對 GBM 適應症的美國 FDA 孤兒藥資格 (ODD) 申請規劃。若順利取得，將可獲得法規審查加速、賦稅優惠及市場獨占期等優勢，強化國際臨床開發、國際授權合作及多中心臨床的競爭力。
展望後市，董事長劉銖淇將持續推進 CAR001 臨床開發、國際法規布局與全球授權合作，並結合 CDMO 事業，打造「CDMO + 創新細胞治療」雙引擎發展策略。
paras_en: Changsheng (6712-TW) announced its July revenue of NT$99.25 million, with double-digit growth year-over-year and month-over-month. The company attributed this to the rising demand in the regenerative medicine and cell therapy markets, which drove the stable growth of its CDMO business. The 'CDMO + new drug development' dual-engine strategy continues to ferment.

Changsheng's July revenue was NT$99.25 million, up 5.72% month-over-month and 20.72% year-over-year. The cumulative revenue for the first seven months of the year was NT$559 million, up 16.31% year-over-year.

Changsheng stated that its self-developed allogeneic, off-the-shelf CAR-T cell therapy new drug CA002 has completed the Phase 1 dose-escalation trial in the US and Taiwan, demonstrating good safety and no dose-limiting toxicity (DLT). It has passed the safety monitoring committee (SMC) review and officially entered the Phase 2a efficacy verification stage, with the first patient enrolled.

Changsheng noted that due to glioblastoma (GBM) being a common and aggressive primary malignant tumor in adults with poor clinical prognosis, the company has initiated the planning for the US FDA orphan drug designation (ODD) application for CAR001 targeting GBM. If successful, it will gain advantages such as accelerated regulatory review, tax incentives, and market exclusivity, enhancing its international clinical development, licensing cooperation, and multi-center clinical trial competitiveness.

Looking ahead, Chairman Liu Chunqi will continue to push forward the clinical development of CAR001, international regulatory layout, and global licensing cooperation, while combining the CDMO business to build a 'CDMO + innovative cell therapy' dual-engine development strategy.

items.title: 億光在美控告日亞化 提起LED專利侵權訴訟
items.title_en: Everlight Sues Nichia in U.S. Over LED Patent Infringement
paras: LED 廠億光 (2393-TW)7 月 30 日向美國密西根東區聯邦地方法院南部分院提起專利侵權訴訟，對日亞化提起專利侵權訴訟，控告日亞化所製造及銷售之高功率 LED 產品侵害億光美國覆晶第 7,554,126 號專利。
在上開訴訟中，億光的美國第 7,554,126 號專利涉及 LED 覆晶和封裝製程，透過調整 N/P 電極的面積比例，使 LED 晶片與焊料具有良好接著性，可兼顧高散熱及封裝可靠度。
此項關鍵技術應用範疇極為廣泛，除了可應用於閃光燈 LED 產品外，亦適用於車用 LED 產品、高功率照明與顯示等領域，屬 LED 覆晶封裝關鍵技術。對於 美國第 7,554,126 專利，億光於下列國家擁有家族專利：美國、日本、中國等地區。
億光聲明，日亞化的特定 LED 產品已使用億光美國覆晶第 7,554,126 號專利技術。該專利不僅可用於移動裝置光學元件產品，更可涵蓋消費性電子元件、照明、燈絲、UVC、車用光學元件 LED 、CSP、背光、閃光燈及 Mini/Micro LED 等多個領域。
億光重申專利權主要的目的是為了保護創新研發成果，並且鼓勵產業發展；針對市場上不法的侵權行為，億光必要時將採取法律行動，絕不寬貸，以捍衛億光尊重智慧財產權之一貫立場。
億光不斷投入及擴充技術及產品的研發、製造及設計的能力，加深智慧財產權的佈局，以強化產品的競爭力。目前已取得美、中、日、歐、韓及台等地區多件關鍵專利，將持續提供客戶優質的服務以及產品。
paras_en: Everlight (2393-TW) filed a patent infringement lawsuit on July 30 in the Southern Division of the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Michigan, accusing Nichia of infringing Everlight's U.S. flip‑chip patent No. 7,554,126 with its high‑power LED products.

In the complaint, Everlight's U.S. Patent No. 7,554,126 relates to LED flip‑chip and packaging processes. By adjusting the area ratio of the N‑type and P‑type electrodes, the LED chip achieves good adhesion to the solder, allowing both high heat dissipation and reliable packaging.

This key technology has a very broad scope of application. In addition to flash‑LED products, it can be used in automotive LEDs, high‑power lighting, displays and other fields, making it a critical technology for LED flip‑chip packaging. Everlight holds a family of patents covering U.S. Patent No. 7,554,126 in the United States, Japan, China and other regions.

Everlight states that certain Nichia LED products already employ the technology covered by its U.S. flip‑chip Patent No. 7,554,126. The patent can be used not only for optical components in mobile devices but also for consumer‑electronics components, lighting, filaments, UVC, automotive optical‑component LEDs, CSP, backlighting, flash LEDs and Mini/Micro LEDs.

Everlight reiterates that the primary purpose of its patents is to protect innovative R&D results and to encourage industry development; it will take legal action against unlawful infringement in the market and will not be lenient in defending its steadfast respect for intellectual‑property rights.

Everlight continuously invests in and expands its capabilities in technology and product development, manufacturing and design, deepening its IP portfolio to strengthen product competitiveness. It has already obtained numerous key patents in the United States, China, Japan, Europe, South Korea and Taiwan, and will continue to provide customers with high‑quality services and products.

items.title: 光寶科(2301)｜法人全面上修今、明兩年獲利預估，原來市場沒估到這件事
items.title_en: Lite-On Technology (2301) | Institutional Investors Fully Upgrade Profit Forecasts for This Year and Next, Market Missed This Factor
paras: 2026年08月04日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 光寶科(2301)近期獲法人調升今、明兩年每股盈餘預估，最大的關鍵在於上半年財報公布，營業利益率遠優於預期，顯示市場低估了AI產品獲利貢獻，以及公司的經營效率。因此法人以更高的獲利率作為新的預估基礎，全面上修今、明兩年獲利預期。
其次，AI電源產品放量速度以及新一代電力架構導入時程均優於市場原先預期，也使得法人不得不重新調整未來獲利模型，以反應最新情況。
原本法人多預估8kW以上AI伺服器電源、BBU及Power Rack等產品，將於2026年下半年至2027年才開始明顯貢獻，但實際出貨進度提前，使AI產品營收占比快速提升，高毛利產品貢獻也比原先模型更早發酵。
除了既有的出貨產品線之外，新一代電力架構的導入進度同樣超出市場預期。
800VDC、Power Rack及液冷等高價值產品已提前進入驗證、試產及小量出貨階段，意味著公司正由傳統電源供應器供應商，逐步擴大至AI機櫃電力系統解決方案供應商。
由於光寶科的實際發展明顯超出市場原先預期，法人不得不全面翻新獲利預測，也帶動市場重新評價公司價值。因此，在這一波估值修正過程中，光寶科的股價表現明顯優於台達電。
雖然台達電2026年的營收成長、獲利規模與AI業務占比仍高於光寶科，但這些優勢大多早已反映在原本的股價與評價中。台達電的投資邏輯，是在高基期上維持穩定成長；光寶科則是從市場原先較低的期待，逐步轉型為AI電力系統供應商。
對股價來說，市場原本越沒有預期，後續一旦獲利、產品進度與公司定位都超出預期，重新評價的空間就越大。這也是光寶科這一波股價彈性高於台達電的主要原因。

paras_en: On August 4, 2026 (Youshixun / Industry Data Center report) – Lite-On Technology (2301) has recently had its earnings per share estimates for this year and next year raised by institutional investors, mainly because the first‑half financial results showed operating margins far above expectations, indicating the market underestimated the profit contribution of AI products and the company's operational efficiency. Consequently, investors are using a higher profit margin as the new basis for their forecasts, fully revising profit expectations for the current and next year.

In addition, the rollout speed of AI power products and the timeline for introducing the next‑generation power architecture both exceeded market expectations, forcing investors to adjust their profit models to reflect the latest situation.

Originally, investors expected that AI server power supplies above 8 kW, BBUs and Power Racks would only start making a noticeable contribution in the second half of 2026 through 2027, but actual shipment progress has accelerated, quickly raising the share of AI product revenue and allowing high‑margin products to contribute earlier than the previous model anticipated.
Beyond the existing product lines, the deployment schedule for the next‑generation power architecture has also outpaced market expectations.

High‑value items such as 800 VDC, Power Rack and liquid‑cooling solutions have already entered verification, pilot production and limited‑volume shipment stages ahead of schedule, meaning the company is shifting from a traditional power‑supply vendor to an AI rack‑level power‑system solutions provider.

Because Lite-On's actual development has clearly exceeded prior market expectations, investors have had to completely overhaul profit forecasts, prompting a re‑valuation of the company's worth. In this wave of valuation adjustment, Lite-On's stock performance has been noticeably better than Delta Electronics'.

Although Delta Electronics' 2026 revenue growth, profit scale and AI business share remain higher than Lite-On's, those advantages have largely already been reflected in its stock price and valuation. Delta's investment logic is to maintain stable growth on a high base, whereas Lite-On is transitioning from a lower market expectation to become an AI power‑system supplier.

For the stock price, the less the market expects initially, the larger the upside when earnings, product progress and company positioning exceed expectations, leaving more room for re‑rating. This is the main reason Lite-On's recent stock elasticity has outperformed Delta Electronics'.

items.title: 財經名嘴：華爾街最新「籃子交易」正創造逢低布局機會
items.title_en: CNBC's Jim Cramer: Wall Street's 'Basket Trades' Are Creating Buying Opportunities
paras: 《CNBC》財經節目主持人 Jim Cramer 周一 (3 日) 表示，華爾街近期盛行的「籃子交易(Basket Trades)」正在扭曲許多股票的價格表現，投資人反而可以利用這些錯價尋找布局機會。
Cramer 在節目中談到，「最棒的事？就是這些交易創造了真正的投資機會。在公司公布財報前，股價往往會脫離基本面。」
「當市場以籃子交易形成的估值，遇上真正的財報表現時，就有機會帶來可觀的獲利。」
Cramer 指出，交易員愈來愈傾向依照特定主題將股票歸類成不同「籃子」，使同一類股票同步上漲或下跌，而不是根據各家公司本身的基本面來決定股價。
他表示，這類交易方式尤其在中東衝突持續期間主導每日走勢，但很多時候與企業長期前景並沒有太大關聯。
Cramer 以波音 (Boeing)(BA-US) 為例指出，近期波音股價愈來愈受到中東地緣政治消息影響。當市場看到外交談判取得進展時，波音股價便上漲，若衝突升溫，股價則同步下跌。但他認為，這些每日新聞並不會改變波音長期的投資價值。
Cramer 表示，「真正決定波音價值的，是現金流與飛機生產能力，而不是把波音當成交易工具。」他指出，波音目前握有約 6,200 架飛機的積壓訂單，這遠比中東局勢短期變化更值得投資人關注。

根據 Cramer，零售股近期也成為典型的籃子交易。當中東局勢緊張、油價走高引發市場對通膨的擔憂時，投資人開始轉向好市多 (Costco)(COST-US) 與沃爾瑪 (Walmart)(WMT-US)，因市場認為，在消費者因油價上漲而縮減支出時，這兩家公司將是受惠者，同時賣出 Ralph Lauren(RL-US)、Target(TGT-US) 及 Williams-Sonoma(WSM-US)等偏非必須性消費的零售股。
他表示，「好市多和沃爾瑪都是優秀、能夠長期持有的零售企業。無論戰爭情勢如何，它們都值得投資。」
Cramer 指出，今年上半年，科技股成為華爾街最熱門籃子交易之一。市場普遍追捧 AI 基礎設施相關股票，同時大舉賣出企業軟體公司，而不論各家公司本身的營運表現如何。
他表示，市場普遍認為，AI 熱潮最大的受惠者將是硬體供應商，而企業軟體業者則可能因 AI 衝擊傳統按席位收費模式而面臨壓力。不過，隨著這股交易趨勢開始反轉，基本面較佳的企業開始脫穎而出。ServiceNow(NOW-US) 與 Salesforce(CRM-US) 等公司已逐漸擺脫整體軟體族群同步波動的影響，開始反映自身基本面的價值。
Cramer 坦言，短期內，籃子交易確實可能壓過企業基本面，主導股價走勢。但他認為，每逢財報季，市場最終仍會重新把焦點放回各家公司本身的營運表現。
他談到，「很高興看到基本面終究還是重要的，即使這種情況一年只有四次，在財報季時才會發生。」
paras_en: CNBC's Jim Cramer said on Monday that Wall Street's recent 'basket trades' are distorting the price performance of many stocks, but investors can use these mispricings to find buying opportunities.
Cramer said, 'The best thing is that these trades are creating real investment opportunities. Before companies report their earnings, stock prices tend to diverge from their fundamental value.'
He added, 'When the market's valuation based on basket trades meets the actual earnings performance, it can lead to significant profits.'

Cramer pointed out that traders are increasingly inclined to categorize stocks into different 'baskets' based on specific themes, causing stocks in the same category to move in tandem, rather than being determined by each company's fundamental value.
He noted that this type of trading is particularly prevalent during periods of Middle East conflict, but often has little to do with the long-term prospects of the companies involved.

Cramer used Boeing (BA-US) as an example, saying that the company's stock price has been increasingly influenced by Middle East geopolitical news. When diplomatic talks progress, Boeing's stock price rises, and when tensions escalate, it falls. However, he believes that these daily news events will not change Boeing's long-term investment value.

Cramer said, 'What really determines Boeing's value is its cash flow and aircraft production capacity, not treating Boeing as a trading tool.' He noted that Boeing currently has about 6,200 aircraft on order, which is a much more significant factor for investors to consider than short-term changes in Middle East tensions.

According to Cramer, retail stocks have also become a typical example of basket trading. When Middle East tensions are high and oil prices rise, investors start to shift towards Costco (COST-US) and Walmart (WMT-US), which are seen as beneficiaries in a scenario where consumers reduce spending due to higher oil prices.
He said, 'Costco and Walmart are excellent, long-term retail companies. Regardless of the war situation, they are worth investing in.'

Cramer pointed out that in the first half of this year, tech stocks became one of the most popular basket trades on Wall Street. The market widely chased AI infrastructure-related stocks while selling off enterprise software companies, regardless of their individual operating performance.

He said, 'The market widely believes that the AI trend will benefit hardware suppliers, while enterprise software companies may face pressure due to the disruption of traditional per-seat pricing models.' However, as this trading trend begins to reverse, companies with better fundamentals are starting to emerge.

ServiceNow (NOW-US) and Salesforce (CRM-US) are examples of companies that have gradually escaped the influence of the overall software sector's volatility and are starting to reflect their own fundamental values.

Cramer said, 'In the short term, basket trades may indeed overpower company fundamentals and drive stock prices. However, he believes that every time earnings season comes around, the market will eventually refocus on the operating performance of individual companies.'
He said, 'It's great to see that fundamentals still matter, even if it only happens four times a year during earnings season.'

items.title: 密西根州環孢子蟲病死亡人數升至2人 Sweetgreen崩逾8%、百勝餐飲挫近3%
items.title_en: Michigan Cyclospora Death Toll Rises to 2, Sweetgreen Plummets Over 8%, YUM Brands Slides Nearly 3%
paras: 美國爆發近年規模最大的環孢子蟲疫情，密西根州週一 (3 日) 通報死亡人數增至 2 人，累計病例攀升至 11,234 例，帶動餐飲股遭到拋售。投資人開始重新評估這場食源性疾病事件對消費意願、餐廳來客數及營收的衝擊。
密西根州衛生部表示，該州病例數較上週五增加 461 例，其中共有 193 人住院。兩名死者均患嚴重慢性病，或受環孢子蟲病及脫水影響致死。這是為美國爆發全美疫情以來，首次有死亡個案。
沙拉連鎖品牌 Sweetgreen (SG-US) 與美式墨西哥速食連鎖品牌 Taco Bell 母公司百勝餐飲集團 (YUM-US)，成為這波疫情中市場關注的兩家公司。
Sweetgreen 雖未被認定與受污染生菜供應鏈有關，卻因消費者普遍減少購買生菜產品而受到波及；百勝餐飲則已證實，Taco Bell 美國門市銷售受到直接影響。
Sweetgreen 週一暴跌 8.22%，報每股 5.92 美元，盤中最低觸及 5.87 美元。成交量超過 1,021.29 萬股，逐步接近過去 3 個月平均每日 580 萬股的水準，賣壓相當沉重。
這波跌勢也使 Sweetgreen 股價進一步逼近低點。該股過去一年累計蒸發逾 52%，目前距離 52 週低點 4.49 美元僅約 1.43 美元，並遠低於同期高點 12.88 美元。
Sweetgreen 並未使用涉事供應鏈的生菜，但仍難以避開消費者信心下滑帶來的連帶衝擊。
Marler Blog 引述的客流與消費數據顯示，疫情爆發後數週，Sweetgreen 每週消費金額與去年同期相比減少 10 個百分點，另一家沙拉連鎖品牌 Chopt 的來客數則下滑 12%。
相較之下，百勝餐飲受到的影響更為直接。該公司股價週一下跌約 2.92%，報每股 148.80 美元，盤中一度觸及當日低點 (148.00)。
百勝餐飲股價曾於 7 月 30 日反彈約 4%，主要因公司管理層釋出銷售逐步復甦的訊號。然而，密西根州最新公布的死亡病例，使市場先前對需求回穩的樂觀情緒明顯降溫。
百勝餐飲執行長 Chris Turner 日前表示，疫情初期升高的不確定性曾壓抑消費需求，但消費者後來逐漸理解，這是影響整個餐飲產業的事件，並非 Taco Bell 單一品牌的問題。
百勝餐飲同時揭露，第三季迄今，Taco Bell 美國門市同店銷售下滑 2%。銷售受到最明顯衝擊的時間約在 7 月 18 日，也就是 Taco Bell 將問題生菜撤出全美餐廳的隔天。
美國食品藥物管理局 (FDA) 調查指出，這波疫情與 Taylor Farms 位於墨西哥中部營運據點供應的結球萵苣有關。Taco Bell 於 7 月 17 日停用相關產品，Taylor Farms 則在隔日宣布召回。
疫情目前已擴散至全美 9 個州，其中密西根州災情最為嚴重。韋恩郡 (Wayne County) 累計通報 1,379 起病例；從年齡分布來看，30 至 39 歲成年人是受影響最多的族群。
疫情對消費需求造成的衝擊，也已超出直接使用問題生菜的餐飲業者。Marler Blog 引述 NielsenIQ 數據顯示，全美新鮮生菜單位銷量一週內下滑 9%，兩週累計跌幅擴大至 19%，對以沙拉及生菜餐點為主的品牌形成更大壓力。
《路透》先前引述 Placer.ai 代表說法指出，客流量曾大幅下降的連鎖餐廳仍面臨顧客減少的情況。該機構原本認為最嚴重的階段可能已經過去，但最新死亡病例消息，再度增加餐飲需求復甦的不確定性。
市場下一個觀察重點，將是 Sweetgreen 預定於 8 月 6 日週四美股盤後公布的 2026 年第二季財報。市場共識預估，該公司本季營收為 1.946 億美元，每股虧損 0.13 美元。
不過，投資人可能更關注管理層如何說明第三季同店銷售與來客數走勢，以及公司是否具體量化這波疫情對營收造成的影響。
paras_en: The United States is experiencing its largest cyclospora outbreak in recent years, with Michigan reporting on Monday (the 3rd) that the death toll has risen to two and total cases have climbed to 11,234, prompting a sell‑off in restaurant stocks. Investors are re‑evaluating the impact of this food‑borne illness on consumer willingness to spend, restaurant foot traffic, and revenue.

Michigan's health department said the state saw an increase of 461 cases since last Friday, with 193 hospitalizations. Both deceased individuals had serious chronic conditions and died from a combination of cyclospora infection and dehydration. This marks the first fatality in the nationwide U.S. outbreak.
Salad chain Sweetgreen (SG‑US) and the parent of fast‑casual Mexican chain Taco Bell, YUM Brands (YUM‑US), have become the two companies most closely watched amid the outbreak.

Although Sweetgreen has not been linked to the contaminated lettuce supply chain, it has been hit by a general decline in consumer purchases of lettuce products; YUM Brands has confirmed that Taco Bell’s U.S. sales have been directly affected.

Sweetgreen’s shares tumbled 8.22% on Monday, closing at $5.92, with intraday lows of $5.87. Trading volume exceeded 10.2129 million shares, approaching the three‑month average daily volume of 5.8 million, indicating heavy selling pressure.

The decline also pushed Sweetgreen’s price closer to its lows. The stock has shed more than 52% over the past year and is now about $1.43 above its 52‑week low of $4.49, far below its prior high of $12.88.
Even though Sweetgreen does not use lettuce from the implicated supply chain, it cannot escape the broader hit to consumer confidence.

Data cited by Marler Blog on foot traffic and spending show that in the weeks following the outbreak, Sweetgreen’s weekly spend per customer fell 10 percentage points versus the same period last year, while another salad chain, Chopt, saw a 12% drop in visits.
By contrast, YUM Brands felt a more direct impact. Its stock fell about 2.92% on Tuesday, closing at $148.80, briefly touching an intraday low of $148.00.
YUM’s shares had rallied about 4% on July 30 after management signaled a gradual sales recovery, but the newly reported Michigan deaths cooled the earlier optimism about demand rebounding.

YUM CEO Chris Turner recently said that the heightened uncertainty early in the outbreak suppressed consumer demand, but shoppers have since come to understand that this is an industry‑wide issue, not just a problem for the Taco Bell brand.

YUM also disclosed that, through Q3, same‑store sales at U.S. Taco Bell locations are down 2%. The sharpest sales impact occurred around July 18, the day after Taco Bell withdrew the problematic lettuce from all U.S. restaurants.

The FDA’s investigation linked the outbreak to whole‑head lettuce supplied by Taylor Farms from a processing site in central Mexico. Taco Bell stopped using the product on July 17, and Taylor Farms announced a recall the following day.
The outbreak has now spread to nine states nationwide, with Michigan hardest hit. Wayne County alone has reported 1,379 cases; adults aged 30‑39 represent the largest affected age group.

The shock to consumer demand extends beyond restaurants that directly use the tainted lettuce. Marler Blog, citing NielsenIQ, reported that U.S. fresh lettuce unit sales fell 9% in one week and a cumulative 19% over two weeks, adding pressure to brands that rely heavily on salads and lettuce‑based dishes.

Reuters previously quoted Placer.ai, noting that chains that saw sharp foot‑traffic declines are still experiencing reduced patronage. The firm had thought the worst phase might be over, but the latest death reports revive uncertainty about a dining‑demand recovery.

The next market focus will be Sweetgreen’s Q2 2026 earnings, scheduled for after‑hours release on Thursday, August 6. Consensus forecasts project revenue of $194.6 million and a loss of $0.13 per share for the quarter.
Investors are likely to watch closely how management explains Q3 same‑store sales and traffic trends, and whether the company can quantify the specific revenue impact of the outbreak.

items.title: 微軟創26年來最強三日！年初失土全收復 AI布局開始開花結果
items.title_en: Microsoft Posts Strongest Three-Day Run in 26 Years as AI Strategy Starts Paying Off
paras: 微軟 (MSFT-US) 股價周一 (3 日) 再漲 4.9%，過去三個交易日累計勁揚 24.9%，創 2000 年 10 月以來最佳三日表現，並一舉收復今年以來跌幅，反映市場對其人工智慧 (AI) 布局的疑慮明顯降溫。
微軟 2026 年累計上漲約 0.8%。根據道瓊市場數據，微軟曾在 2000 年 10 月出現三天累計上漲 29.24% 的傲人表現。
微軟上周公布財報，旗下 Azure 雲端業務營收增速加快，執行長納德拉 (Satya Nadella) 並表示，AI 助理 Copilot 付費用戶已突破 3000 萬個，新增付費用戶數較前一季增加超過一倍。
GraniteShares 執行長 Rhind 表示，這些數據讓投資人相信，微軟近年大舉投入 AI 的資本支出已開始產生回報，「這波漲勢之所以有機會延續，是因為微軟終於回答市場過去 18 個月一直在問的問題，也就是龐大的 AI 資本支出是否能帶來足夠報酬。」
他表示，周一股價續揚並非只是財報行情延續，而是市場重新評價微軟 AI 發展進度，願意給予更高估值。
Rational Equity Armor Fund 投資組合經理 Rahbari 表示，隨著各大超大規模雲端服務商 (hyperscaler) 競相投入 AI，企業資本支出已進入「未知領域」，但業者願意持續擴大投資，代表他們看見足以支撐投資回報的需求。
微軟也在財報中向投資人保證，新會計年度預期仍可讓自由現金流保持在正值，不會因 AI 投資而轉為負值。
儘管 AI 投資金額持續攀升，微軟及其他超大規模雲端服務商仍普遍表示，目前基礎設施供給仍無法完全滿足市場需求，顯示企業 AI 建置需求依然強勁。
paras_en: Microsoft (MSFT-US) shares rose another 4.9% on Monday (the 3rd), marking a cumulative gain of 24.9% over the past three trading days – the best three‑day performance since October 2000 – and fully recouping the losses it suffered earlier this year, reflecting a clear cooling of market doubts about its artificial‑intelligence (AI) rollout.

Microsoft is up about 0.8% for the year to date. According to Dow Jones market data, the last time Microsoft posted a three‑day gain of this magnitude was in October 2000, when it surged 29.24% over three sessions.

Microsoft reported its earnings last week, showing an accelerating revenue growth rate for its Azure cloud business. CEO Satya Nadella said the paid‑user base for the AI assistant Copilot has now surpassed 30 million, more than double the number added in the prior quarter.

GraniteShares CEO Rhind said these figures give investors confidence that Microsoft’s massive recent AI capital spending is beginning to generate returns, adding, “The reason this rally could continue is that Microsoft finally answered the question the market has been asking for the past 18 months – whether the huge AI capex can deliver sufficient payoff.”
He added that Monday’s price rise is not merely a continuation of the earnings reaction, but a market re‑assessment of Microsoft’s AI development progress, warranting a higher valuation.

Rational Equity Armor Fund portfolio manager Rahbari noted that as the hyperscalers race to pour money into AI, corporate capex has entered an “unknown territory,” yet the willingness of vendors to keep expanding investment signals they see demand strong enough to support returns.
Microsoft also told investors in its earnings release that it expects free cash flow to remain positive in the new fiscal year and not turn negative because of AI spending.

Despite AI investment continuing to climb, Microsoft and other hyperscalers generally say that current infrastructure supply still cannot fully meet market demand, indicating that corporate AI deployment needs remain robust.

items.title: iPhone Fold生產難題傳已解決 預計9月如期問世
items.title_en: iPhone Fold Production Issues Reportedly Resolved, Expected to Launch in September
paras: 蘋果首款摺疊式手機 iPhone Fold 傳出已克服量產瓶頸，產品設計不必大幅修改，仍按照原定時程推進，可望於 2026 年 9 月與新一代 iPhone 同場亮相。不過，消息尚未獲得蘋果證實。
爆料者「定焦數碼」(Fixed Focus Digital) 在微博透露，iPhone Fold 初期試產時確實遭遇製造困難。蘋果起初僅生產少量測試機，問題主要出現在產能由小批量試產轉向大規模量產的階段，一度難以順利提高產量。
相關技術與製造障礙據稱目前均已排除，也未迫使蘋果重新設計產品。最終上市版本預料將大致延續 2026 年初確立的設計方案，不會出現外界先前傳聞的大幅調整。
市場此前一度將生產問題指向摺疊轉軸。
部分報導稱，蘋果 (AAPL-US) 的創新轉軸設計可能導致量產進度落後，甚至迫使公司修改整體設計；但最新爆料否認產品曾經延期，並強調轉軸及其他製造難題已經解決。
供應鏈動向也支持產品按期推出的說法。近期消息顯示，多家零組件供應商仍在持續生產 iPhone Fold 所需零件，且尚未收到蘋果通知產品將大幅延期。
不過，「定焦數碼」過去爆料並非百分百準確。
該帳號曾率先正確披露 iPhone 16e 的名稱，但也曾錯誤預測 iPhone 17 將採用不支援 ProMotion 的 120Hz 螢幕。因此，iPhone Fold 能否如期於 9 月登場，仍有待蘋果正式公布。
paras_en: Apple's first foldable iPhone, iPhone Fold, has reportedly overcome production bottlenecks and is expected to launch in September alongside the new generation of iPhones. However, the company has not yet confirmed the news.

A source, Fixed Focus Digital, revealed on Weibo that iPhone Fold encountered manufacturing difficulties during its initial trial production. Apple initially produced only a small number of test units, and the main problem arose when transitioning from small-batch trial production to large-scale mass production, making it difficult to increase production smoothly.

According to the source, the related technologies and manufacturing obstacles have been eliminated, and there is no need for Apple to redesign the product. The final version of the product is expected to largely follow the design scheme established in early 2026, without the significant adjustments previously rumored.

Market analysts had previously pointed to the production problem as being related to the folding axis. Some reports suggested that Apple's innovative axis design might have caused production delays, even forcing the company to modify the overall design. However, the latest leak denies that the product was delayed and emphasizes that the axis and other manufacturing issues have been resolved.

Supply chain trends also support the statement that the product will be launched on schedule. Recent news shows that multiple component suppliers are still producing the necessary components for iPhone Fold, and they have not received any notification from Apple that the product will be significantly delayed.

However, Fixed Focus Digital's past leaks have not been 100% accurate. The account previously correctly revealed the name of iPhone 16e, but also incorrectly predicted that iPhone 17 would use a 120Hz screen that does not support ProMotion. Therefore, whether iPhone Fold will launch on schedule in September remains to be seen until Apple officially announces it.

items.title: 摩根大通潑冷水 科技股下半年退居二線、警惕「AI蠶食領域」
items.title_en: JPMorgan Cools Tech Stocks, Warns of 'AI Cannibalization' in Key Sectors
paras: 摩根大通銀行 (JPM-US) 表示，科技股恐難在今年下半年繼續扮演股市主要推升力量。
由 Mislav Matejka 領軍的策略團隊週一 (3 日) 在報告中指出，與科技及人工智慧產業連動的個股，將不再重現 2025 年下半年那般主導市場的盛況。其中一項原因是，他們預期「美股七巨頭」（Magnificent Seven）的表現將不再占據市場主導地位，投資焦點可能逐漸轉向其他產業。
策略師亦呼籲投資人對所謂「AI 蠶食領域」（AI cannibalization areas）保持警惕，特別是軟體、商業服務及媒體等類股。他們師認為，儘管這些領域在 AI 威脅下展現出韌性，但長期來看仍將持續掙扎，不過鑑於此前已出現大幅修正，市場短期內或有戰術性反彈的空間。
事實上，由於市場擔憂軟體業的商業模式恐遭 AI 全面顛覆，相關個股自 1 月以來已歷經顯著拋售。
投資配置上，摩根大通策略師目前更偏好半導體類股，勝過超大規模雲端運算（hyperscalers）及易受 AI 衝擊的企業，尤其考量 AI 相關支出仍可能持續增加。
不過，該行預期，景氣循環股將在下半年引領市場表現，消費循環股也有望迎來較佳走勢。
摩根大通持續看好市場領漲範圍擴大，並點出下半年幾項重要股市驅動因素。首先，美國經濟可能具備韌性，足以承受伊朗衝突帶來的影響。
其次，市場預期聯準會（Fed）將「盡可能維持寬鬆立場」。在衝突爆發前，市場原本押注聯準會降息，但相關預期其後已大幅消退。不過，策略師認為，若未來數月通膨明顯降溫，聯準會可能轉向更為鴿派的政策立場。
此外，第二季企業獲利強勁，以及美國以外市場相對具吸引力的估值，也將成為支撐股市的正面因素。摩根大通指出，以本益比衡量，目前美股平均本益比為 20.2 倍，相較 20 年中位數高出 21%，顯示估值已明顯偏高；相比之下，英國股市僅高於歷史水準 5%，日本股市則高出 18%。
策略師表示：「若我們對下半年市場參與度持續擴大的判斷正確，加上伊朗衝突未進一步升級，以及市場對 AI 商業化能力的疑慮持續存在，那麼非美股市場連續第二年跑贏美股的機率將提高。」
最後，摩根大通指出，投資人目前可能已降低對熱門半導體股等擁擠交易標的的過度配置，有助於相關族群逐步穩定。令他們感到安心的是，儘管動能因子（momentum factor）出現大幅修正，南韓綜合指數 (KOSPI) 一度重挫近 40%，但半導體類股仍展現韌性。
paras_en: JPMorgan Chase (JPM-US) warned that tech stocks may not continue to drive the market in the second half of the year.

A report by JPMorgan's strategy team, led by Mislav Matejka, said that stocks tied to the tech and artificial intelligence (AI) industries may not repeat the market dominance seen in the second half of 2025.
One reason is that the 'Magnificent Seven' - a group of seven large-cap tech stocks - are expected to lose their market-leading status, and investors may shift their focus to other sectors.
The strategists also cautioned investors to be wary of 'AI cannibalization areas,' particularly software, business services, and media stocks.

Although these sectors have shown resilience in the face of AI threats, they are expected to continue struggling in the long term, but with a recent sharp correction, there may be a tactical rebound in the short term.
In fact, due to concerns that software companies' business models may be completely disrupted by AI, related stocks have seen significant selling since January.
On the investment side, JPMorgan's strategists prefer semiconductor stocks over hyperscalers and companies vulnerable to AI disruption, given the potential for continued AI-related spending.
However, the bank expects cyclical stocks to lead market performance in the second half, with consumer cyclical stocks also expected to see better performance.
JPMorgan continues to expect market leadership to expand and highlights several key drivers for the second half, including a resilient US economy that can withstand the impact of the Iran conflict.
The bank also expects the Federal Reserve to maintain a dovish stance, with the possibility of a more dovish policy if inflation cools significantly in the coming months.
Other supporting factors include strong second-quarter earnings and relatively attractive valuations in non-US markets.

JPMorgan notes that the current S&P 500 price-to-earnings ratio of 20.2 is 21% above its 20-year median, indicating a significant overvaluation, while the UK and Japanese markets are only 5% and 18% above their historical averages, respectively.

The strategists say: 'If our assumption of continued participation in the market in the second half is correct, and the Iran conflict does not escalate further, and market concerns about AI commercialization continue to exist, then the probability of non-US markets outperforming the US market for the second consecutive year will increase.'
Finally, JPMorgan notes that investors may have reduced their over-allocation to popular semiconductor stocks and other crowded trades, which could help stabilize these groups.

items.title: 立竿見影！韓槓桿ETF門檻翻倍　個股槓桿ETF交易額暴跌90%
items.title_en: ETF Trading Volume Plunges 90% as South Korea Raises Margin Requirements
paras: 最新數據顯示，自南韓金融監管當局將單一標的槓桿 / 反向 ETF 基礎保證金由 1000 萬韓元調高至 3000 萬韓元後僅兩個交易日，相關產品交易規模急凍至新規前十分之一，散戶集中獲利了結，市場過熱迅速降溫。
根據韓國交易所 (KRX) 周一 (3 日) 數據，以三星電子、SK 海力士為底層資產的 16 檔單股槓桿 / 反向 ETF 合計成交額約 1.2 兆韓元；對比保證金上調前最後交易日 (7 月 30 日) 的 12.4 兆韓元，僅剩一成，較新規上路首日 (7 月 31 日) 約 3 兆韓元也再腰斬。
在上周五 (7 月 31 日)，無任何單品破 1 兆韓元，規模最大的 KODEX SK 海力士槓桿 ETF 成交 4226 億韓元，較 7 月 30 日 3.6 兆縮至八分之一；SOL SK 海力士 2 倍反向 ETF 由 5 兆以上摔至 1807 億韓元。KODEX SK 海力士槓桿 ETF 成交量續降至 4400 萬股，為前一交易日四分之一。
散戶連兩日淨賣超，當日淨砍 KODEX SK 海力士槓桿 235 億、SOL SK 海力士 2 倍反向 303 億、KODEX 三星電子槓桿 136 億韓元；16 檔中淨買入最高者僅 2 億韓元。
周一，三星電子、SK 海力士分別收跌 8.76%、8.79%，14 檔槓桿 ETF 收跌 13% 至 18%，反向 ETF 則走揚，追蹤海力士者漲約 23%、三星約 12%。
雖然南韓監管「去槓桿」立竿見影，但三星、SK 海力士雙雄現股重挫顯示，關掉散戶槓桿閥門後，基本面與外資流向才是下一步波動主角。
paras_en: Data shows that after South Korea's financial regulator raised the base margin requirement for single-stock leveraged/ inverse ETFs from 10 million KRW to 30 million KRW, trading volumes for related products plummeted to one-tenth of the previous level within two trading days, with retail investors rushing to close their positions and the market rapidly cooling off.

According to the Korea Exchange (KRX), the total trading volume for 16 single-stock leveraged/inverse ETFs with Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix as underlying assets was approximately 12 trillion KRW on Monday (3rd), compared to 124 trillion KRW on the last trading day before the margin increase (July 30th), which is only one-tenth of the previous level, and even lower than the first trading day under the new rules (July 31st) of approximately 30 trillion KRW.

On Friday (July 31st), no single product exceeded 1 trillion KRW, with the largest KODEX SK Hynix Leveraged ETF trading 4226 billion KRW, down to one-eighth of the previous day's 3.6 trillion KRW, and the SOL SK Hynix 2x Inverse ETF plummeting from over 5 trillion KRW to 1807 billion KRW.
The trading volume of the KODEX SK Hynix Leveraged ETF continued to decline to 44 million shares, which is one-fourth of the previous trading day.

Retail investors have been net sellers for two consecutive days, with net sales of KODEX SK Hynix Leveraged 235 billion KRW, SOL SK Hynix 2x Inverse 303 billion KRW, and KODEX Samsung Electronics Leveraged 136 billion KRW; the highest net buy-in among the 16 products was only 2 billion KRW.

On Monday, Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix fell by 8.76% and 8.79%, respectively, while the 14 leveraged ETFs fell by 13% to 18%, and the inverse ETFs rose, with SK Hynix tracking a 23% gain and Samsung Electronics a 12% gain.

Although South Korea's regulator has achieved 'de-leveraging' in just two days, the sharp decline in Samsung and SK Hynix shares suggests that the fundamental factors and foreign capital flows will be the main drivers of the next market fluctuations.
