items.title: 小摩：AI變現疑慮未解 七雄恐難再領漲下半年股市 資金轉向景氣循環股
items.title_en: JPMorgan: AI Disruption Concerns Remain Unresolved, 'Big Seven' May Struggle to Lead Market in Second Half
paras: 摩根大通 (JPM-US) 最新策略報告指出，科技股今年下半年恐難再扮演全球股市主要領漲角色。該行認為，市場對超大型雲端服務業者 (Hyperscalers) 龐大 AI 資本支出的疑慮短期內難以消除，軟體等容易受到 AI 衝擊的產業仍將承受賣壓，資金有望逐步轉向景氣循環股以及美國以外市場。
由策略師 Mislav Matejka 領導的團隊在周一發布報告指出，與 2025 年下半年 AI 概念股全面主導市場不同，今年下半年科技及人工智慧相關股票預料將難以維持同樣的領先優勢。
報告指出，「科技七雄」包括 Alphabet (GOOGL-US)、亞馬遜 (AMZN-US)、蘋果 (AAPL-US)、Meta Platforms (META-US)、微軟 (MSFT-US)、輝達 (NVDA-US) 及特斯拉 (TSLA-US)，未來仍可能持續受到市場質疑高額資本支出是否足以帶來相對應獲利回報的影響。
摩根大通同時提醒，投資人仍應審慎看待所謂「AI 蠶食效應 (AI cannibalization)」衝擊較大的產業，包括軟體、企業服務及媒體等領域。報告指出，即使部分企業營運仍展現韌性，長期仍難擺脫 AI 帶來的競爭壓力，不過在股價大幅修正後，短線仍可能出現技術性反彈。
受到 AI 可能顛覆既有商業模式的擔憂影響，軟體股自今年 1 月以來持續遭到拋售。追蹤軟體產業的 iShares Expanded Tech-Software Sector ETF (IGM-US) 今年以來已下跌近 11%；同期追蹤科技七雄的 Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF (MAGS-US) 則幾乎呈現持平。
在科技產業配置方面，摩根大通仍偏好半導體類股，優於超大型雲端服務業者及容易受到 AI 衝擊的企業。該行認為，AI 相關投資支出仍將持續增加，半導體產業可望持續受惠。不過，下半年市場主導力量預計將轉向景氣循環股，其中消費循環類股表現也有望優於大盤。
摩根大通也延續先前觀點，認為美股領漲結構將持續擴散，不再集中於少數大型科技股。報告指出，下半年有數項因素可望支撐全球股市。
首先，美國經濟預料仍能在伊朗戰爭影響下保持韌性。其次，聯邦準備理事會 (Fed) 可望盡可能維持寬鬆立場。報告指出，在中東衝突爆發前，市場原本已反映降息預期，雖然隨後有所收斂，但若未來幾個月通膨明顯降溫，Fed 仍可能重新轉向較為鴿派的政策方向。
此外，第二季企業財報表現強勁，以及美國以外股市相對便宜的估值，也被視為有利股市的重要因素。
摩根大通引用數據指出，目前美股平均本益比 (P/E) 約 20.2 倍，較過去 20 年中位數高出 21%，估值仍偏昂貴；相較之下，英國股市僅高於歷史中位數約 5%，日本股市則高出 18%，估值壓力相對較低。
報告表示，若市場參與度持續擴大、中東局勢未進一步惡化，加上市場對 AI 商業化能力的疑慮持續存在，非美國股市有望連續第二年跑贏美股。
摩根大通也認為，市場擁擠交易已有明顯降溫，投資人對熱門半導體股的過度持倉大致完成調整，有助於半導體族群逐步回穩。
該行指出，儘管近 4 至 6 周動能交易快速降溫，南韓 KOSPI 指數一度重挫約 40%，費城半導體指數 (SOX) 也下跌約 30%，直到上周五才出現反彈，但全球主要股市包括 MSCI 世界指數、標普 500 指數及泛歐 STOXX 600 指數，目前距離歷史高點仍不到 1%，顯示全球股市整體韌性依舊強勁。
paras_en: JPMorgan's latest strategy report suggests that technology stocks may struggle to maintain their leadership role in the global market in the second half of the year. The bank believes that concerns about the massive capital expenditures of hyperscalers will persist in the short term, and software and other industries vulnerable to AI disruption will continue to face selling pressure.

The report, led by strategist Mislav Matejka, notes that while AI concept stocks dominated the market in the second half of 2025, they are unlikely to maintain the same level of leadership in the second half of this year.

The 'Big Seven' technology and AI-related stocks, including Alphabet (GOOGL-US), Amazon (AMZN-US), Apple (AAPL-US), Meta Platforms (META-US), Microsoft (MSFT-US), NVIDIA (NVDA-US), and Tesla (TSLA-US), may continue to face market skepticism about the adequacy of their high capital expenditures to generate corresponding returns.

JPMorgan also warns investors to be cautious of the 'AI cannibalization' impact on industries such as software, enterprise services, and media, which are more vulnerable to disruption. The report notes that even if some companies show resilience, they will still face long-term competitive pressure from AI, but may experience technical rebounds after a sharp price correction.

The software sector has been under pressure since January, with the iShares Expanded Tech-Software Sector ETF (IGM-US) down nearly 11% year-to-date, while the Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF (MAGS-US), which tracks the 'Big Seven' stocks, has been relatively flat.

In terms of technology sector allocation, JPMorgan still prefers semiconductor stocks over hyperscalers and companies vulnerable to AI disruption. The bank believes that AI-related investment spending will continue to increase, benefiting the semiconductor industry.
However, the report expects the market leadership to shift to cyclical stocks, including consumer cyclical stocks, which may outperform the broader market in the second half.

JPMorgan also reiterates its previous view that the US market leadership structure will continue to broaden, no longer concentrated in a few large tech stocks. The report notes that several factors will support the global market in the second half.

Firstly, the US economy is expected to remain resilient despite the impact of the Iran war. Secondly, the Federal Reserve may maintain a dovish stance. The report notes that the market had already priced in rate cuts before the conflict, and while the expectation has since narrowed, if inflation cools significantly over the next few months, the Fed may revert to a more dovish policy direction.
Additionally, the strong second-quarter earnings and relatively cheap valuations of non-US markets are also seen as positive factors for the market.

JPMorgan cites data showing that the US market's average price-to-earnings ratio (P/E) is around 20.2 times, 21% higher than the 20-year median, and still relatively high. In contrast, the UK market is only 5% above its historical median, while the Japanese market is 18% above, with relatively low valuation pressure.

The report concludes that if market participation continues to expand, the Middle East situation does not worsen further, and market concerns about AI commercialization capabilities persist, non-US markets may outperform the US market for the second consecutive year.

JPMorgan also notes that market overcrowding has cooled down, and investors have largely adjusted their over-ownership of popular semiconductor stocks, which has helped the semiconductor group to stabilize.

items.title: 印度政府折價10%出售人壽保險龍頭持股 拚募33億美元
items.title_en: Indian Government Sells Life Insurance Giant Stake at 10% Discount, Aiming to Raise $3.3 Billion
paras: 印度政府宣布，將出售國營印度人壽保險公司 (Life Insurance Corporation of India，LIC) 最多 6.5% 股權，售股價格較周一收盤價折價約 10%，預計最高可募得 3140 億盧比(約 33 億美元)，以推動國營企業釋股計畫，並符合監管機關對最低公眾持股比率的要求。
根據 LIC 周一提交至印度證券交易所的公告，本次公開出售 (Offer for Sale，OFS) 基本規模為出售 2.5% 股權，另設有額外出售 4% 股權的選擇權，若全數出售，政府最高可募得 3140 億盧比(約 33 億美元)。
此次售股價格訂為每股 382 盧比，公開申購將於周二開始、周三截止。
目前印度政府仍持有 LIC 約 96.5% 股權，依照監管規定，須於 2032 年前將持股降至 75%，以符合最低公眾持股比率 (Minimum Public Shareholding) 要求，因此未來仍須持續出售部分持股。
LIC 是印度最大的壽險公司，依保費收入計算，市占率超過 56%。截至 2026 年 3 月底，該公司管理資產規模 (AUM) 達 57.29 兆盧比，約合 6000 億美元，在印度金融市場占有舉足輕重地位。
印度政府早在 2022 年便透過首次公開發行 (IPO) 出售 LIC 3.5% 股權，當時募資逾 27 億美元，為當時印度資本市場規模最大的 IPO 之一。
股價表現方面，今年以來，印度 Nifty 50 指數累計下跌 5.25%，LIC 股價則僅小跌約 0.5%，相對大盤展現較佳抗跌能力。
除了 LIC 之外，印度政府今年稍早也陸續出售多家國營企業持股，包括 Cochin Shipyard、Indian Railways Finance Corp、NHPC 及 Coal India 等公司，根據印度財政部統計，相關釋股合計募得 2100 億盧比 (約 22 億美元)。
市場分析指出，印度政府近年的國企釋股多採折價發行方式，以提升市場承接意願、消化較大量股票供給，同時確保政府減持計畫順利完成。此次 LIC 以較收盤價折價約 10% 出售股份，也延續印度政府近年推動國營企業改革與擴大市場流通股比重的一貫策略。
paras_en: The Indian government announced it will sell up to 6.5% of the state‑owned Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) at a price roughly 10% below Monday’s closing price, potentially raising as much as 314 billion rupees (about $33 billion) to advance its state‑owned‑enterprise divestment plan and meet regulator‑mandated minimum public shareholding requirements.

According to a notice LIC filed with the Indian stock exchange on Monday, the Offer for Sale (OFS) will initially comprise a 2.5% stake, with an additional optional 4% tranche. If the full 6.5% is sold, the government could raise up to 314 billion rupees (about $33 billion).
The sale price is set at 382 rupees per share, with the public subscription opening on Tuesday and closing on Wednesday.

The government currently holds about 96.5% of LIC and, under regulatory rules, must reduce its holding to 75% by 2032 to satisfy the Minimum Public Shareholding requirement, meaning further disposals will be needed in the future.

LIC is India’s largest life insurer, commanding over 56% market share by premium income. As of the end of March 2026, the company’s assets under management totalled 57.29 trillion rupees, roughly $600 billion, giving it a pivotal role in India’s financial markets.
The government first sold a 3.5% stake in LIC via an IPO in 2022, raising more than $2.7 billion – one of the biggest IPOs in the Indian capital market at the time.
In terms of stock performance, the Nifty 50 index has fallen 5.25% year‑to‑date, while LIC’s share price has slipped only about 0.5%, showing relative resilience against the broader market.

Beyond LIC, the government earlier this year has been divesting stakes in several state‑owned firms, including Cochin Shipyard, Indian Railways Finance Corp, NHPC and Coal India. According to the finance ministry, those disposals have collectively raised 210 billion rupees (about $22 billion).

Analysts note that the Indian government has recently favored discounted offerings for state‑owned‑enterprise share sales to boost market appetite and absorb large share supplies, while ensuring the divestment roadmap stays on track. The roughly 10% discount on LIC shares continues this strategy of reforming state‑owned enterprises and increasing the proportion of freely tradable stock.

items.title: 華府智庫CSIS：川普屢次未兌現打擊威脅 讓伊朗認為美國很軟弱
items.title_en: CSIS: Trump's Repeated Failure to Follow Through on Threats Makes Iran See the U.S. as Weak
paras: 美國智庫「戰略與國際問題研究中心 (CSIS)」中東項目主任 Mona Yacoubian 周一(3 日) 警告，川普政府多次對伊朗放出「最嚴厲威脅」卻未在最後關頭兌現打擊行動，已讓德黑蘭解讀為「美國軟弱」，並自認在美伊衝突中佔據上風。
她說：「每次他這樣做，伊朗接收到的訊號就是：美國很軟弱，伊朗佔了上風。」
Yacoubian 也整理出當前的「軍事升級→宣布外交突破卻落空→重回相互威脅」的循環模式。
她認為，這種「狼來了」式的操作削弱華府威懾可信度，也讓伊朗更有底氣拖過選舉週期與彈藥消耗期。
Yacoubian 還指出，美國最近一次暫緩打擊，關鍵變數在波斯灣盟友——沙特、阿聯、卡達擔心伊朗會毫不猶豫報復區域基礎設施與能源樞紐，把霍爾木茲風險一次性引爆，因此向白宮施壓踩剎車。
分析指出，特朗普「極限施壓＋臨陣回縮」的談判術，用於商業博弈或尚可，但面對承受痛苦門檻更高的伊朗政體，反襯出華府軍事選項的政治成本：中期選舉將近、油價敏感、彈藥庫存下滑。伊朗則借機把「美國不敢打」內化為心理優勢，在核談判、海峽通行與代理人戰線上同步抬價。
市場與外交圈解讀，若威懾可信度持續流失，下階段風險不在「美國打多大」，而在「伊朗先手多狠」——從無人機騷擾到能源設施靶向攻擊，區域火藥味只會更濃。
paras_en: Mona Yacoubian, director of the Middle East program at the U.S. think tank Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS), warned on Monday (the 3rd) that the Trump administration’s repeated issuance of "the harshest threats" toward Iran without actually carrying out strikes at the last moment has led Tehran to interpret this as "U.S. weakness" and to believe it holds the upper hand in any U.S.-Iran confrontation.
She said, "Every time he does this, the signal Iran receives is: the United States is weak, and Iran has the advantage."
Yacoubian also outlined the current cycle of "military escalation → announced diplomatic breakthrough that falls flat → back to mutual threats."
She believes this "boy‑who‑cried‑wolf" approach erodes the credibility of Washington’s deterrence and gives Iran more confidence to ride out an election cycle and a period of ammunition consumption.

Yacoubian further noted that the most recent U.S. pause on strikes was driven by concerns from Gulf allies—Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Qatar—that Iran might retaliate without hesitation against regional infrastructure and energy hubs, potentially igniting a one‑off crisis in the Strait of Hormuz, prompting them to pressure the White House to hit the brakes.

Analysts say Trump’s “maximum pressure plus last‑minute retreat” negotiating style might work in commercial games, but against an Iranian regime with a higher pain threshold it highlights the political cost of U.S. military options: a looming midterm election, oil‑price sensitivity, and dwindling ammunition stockpiles. Iran, meanwhile, is turning the perception that "the U.S. won’t dare to strike" into a psychological advantage, raising its demands simultaneously in nuclear talks, Strait navigation and proxy‑war fronts.

Market observers and diplomats interpret that if deterrence credibility continues to erode, the next risk is not how big a U.S. strike could be, but how aggressively Iran might act first—ranging from drone harassment to targeted attacks on energy facilities—making the regional powder keg even more volatile.

items.title: 三星晶圓代工產能利用率衝100% 最快Q3轉虧為盈
items.title_en: Samsung Foundry Sees 100% Utilization Rate in Q3, Turning Loss to Profit
paras: 在人工智慧（AI）與高頻寬記憶體（HBM）需求的強勁驅動下，三星電子 (005930KS) 晶圓代工下半年的產能利用率有望衝刺 100%，意味著困擾公司逾一年的慢性虧損結構，即將迎來歷史性的轉捩點。
根據韓媒《朝鮮日報》報導，三星晶圓代工目前的產能利用率已處於 70% 至 80% 的區間，結合現有的訂單積壓與各項合約推進進度，年內實現滿產幾乎已成定局。
三星電子在二季度的業績說明會中指出，各製程節點的利用率均較去年同期出現顯著改善，特別是 8 奈米以下的先進製程已達到最高水準，預計今年的 2 奈米項目訂單量將較去年翻倍成長。
儘管公司對於扭虧的確切時點保持審慎，但公開表示該目標在不久的將來即可實現。
市場分析人士普遍樂觀預期，隨著產能利用率回歸常態，加上晶圓價格上漲的有利因素，晶圓代工與系統 LSI 等非存儲業務最快將於第 3 季度、最遲第 4 季度實現轉虧為盈，其獲利改善的速度或將超越市場原本預期。
此波產能利用率的回升，核心動力主要來自兩大主線。首先是第六代高頻寬記憶體（HBM4）採用 4 奈米製程，成功將記憶體市場的景氣週期向晶圓代工業務傳導。
其次，雲端服務供應商（CSP）及人工智慧（AI）、高性能計算（HPC）客戶對於 2 奈米製程的需求持續攀升，包括博通 (AVGO-US) 等國際指標性客戶的項目洽談皆在推進中。
由於半導體代工行業設備投資巨大，屬於典型的高固定成本產業，過去一年因利用率長期低於 50% 導致的嚴重虧損，有望隨著利用率回歸正軌，將新增營收直接轉化為獲利貢獻。
在客戶結構的拓展上，三星晶圓代工正積極擺脫過度依賴單一大客戶的現狀，高通 (QCOM-US) 、AMD(AMD-US) 、谷歌 (GOOGL-US) 等科技巨頭已陸續加入合作洽談，特斯拉(TSLA-US) 據傳也計劃將下一代晶片交由其 2 奈米製程生產，中長期訂單管線顯著增厚。
然而，業界人士強調，要真正拿下高通等巨頭的大規模量產訂單，跨越 2 奈米製程 70% 的良率「生死線」才是決勝關鍵。目前該製程良率約在 60% 區間，仍有進一步提升空間。
綜論所述，三星晶圓代工的業務結構正在進行深層調整，預計今年先進製程的營收佔比將突破 50%，而人工智慧及高性能計算相關業務佔比也將大幅躍升至 30% 以上。
配合美國德州 Taylor 一廠的投產準備，以及二廠的啟動計畫，三星正同步推動產能擴張。
市場分析認為，100% 的產能利用率是業務終結虧損的啟動訊號，但唯有實現 2 奈米良率的穩定突破，才能真正確立三星在先進製程領域的競爭地位，並讓大型客戶的旗艦產品委託代工成為業務重塑的堅實基礎。
paras_en: Driven by strong demand for artificial intelligence (AI) and high-bandwidth memory (HBM), Samsung Electronics' (005930KS) foundry business is expected to reach a 100% utilization rate in the second half of the year, marking a historic turning point for the company's chronic loss structure.

According to a report by the Korean media outlet Chosun Ilbo, Samsung's foundry business currently has a utilization rate of 70-80%, and with existing orders and contract progress, achieving full capacity utilization is almost a certainty for the year.

At its second-quarter earnings briefing, Samsung Electronics noted that utilization rates for all process nodes had improved significantly compared to the same period last year, with advanced processes below 8 nanometers reaching their highest levels. The company expects 2-nanometer orders to grow by more than double year-over-year.
Although the company remains cautious about the exact timing of its goal to turn losses into profits, it has publicly stated that it expects to achieve this goal in the near future.

Market analysts are generally optimistic, expecting that with utilization rates returning to normal and rising memory prices, Samsung's foundry business and system LSI will turn losses into profits as early as the third quarter or at the latest the fourth quarter, with profit improvement potentially exceeding market expectations.

The current surge in utilization rates is driven by two major factors. First, the adoption of 4-nanometer process for the sixth-generation high-bandwidth memory (HBM4) has successfully transmitted the memory market's cyclical trend to the foundry business.

Second, cloud service providers (CSPs) and AI, HPC customers continue to drive demand for 2-nanometer processes, including high-profile customers such as Broadcom (AVGO-US) and Qualcomm (QCOM-US), with project discussions ongoing.

Due to the massive equipment investment in the semiconductor foundry industry, which is a typical high-fixed-cost industry, the severe losses caused by low utilization rates below 50% for the past year are expected to be reversed as utilization rates return to normal, converting additional revenue directly into profit contributions.

In terms of customer structure expansion, Samsung's foundry business is actively working to break away from its over-reliance on a single large customer, with high-profile tech giants such as Google (GOOGL-US), AMD (AMD-US), and Tesla (TSLA-US) joining the fray, with a significant increase in the mid-to-long-term order pipeline.
However, industry insiders emphasize that crossing the '70% yield line' for the 2-nanometer process is the key to securing large-scale production orders from high-profile customers like Qualcomm.
Currently, the 2-nanometer process yield is around 60%, leaving room for further improvement.

In summary, Samsung's foundry business is undergoing a deep structural adjustment, with advanced process revenue expected to exceed 50% of total revenue this year, and AI and HPC-related business expected to jump to over 30%.
In conjunction with the preparation for the Taylor factory in Texas and the startup plan for the second factory, Samsung is simultaneously driving capacity expansion.

Market analysis believes that a 100% utilization rate is a signal to end losses, but only by achieving stable breakthroughs in 2-nanometer yields can Samsung establish a competitive position in the advanced process field and secure flagship product orders from large customers as a solid foundation for business restructuring.

items.title: 美軍已經沒招？伊朗否認與美談判、稱川普是「第十次」TACO
items.title_en: Iran Denies Talks with US, Calls Trump's Threats 'Taco 10'
paras: 伊朗外交部發言人巴加埃週一（3 日）在例行記者會上駁斥美國總統川普稍早的說法，強調德黑蘭目前並未與華盛頓進行任何形式的談判，近期也沒有接待或派遣代表團的計畫。同時，伊媒也指出，這已經是川普第十次在對德黑蘭的「決定性」軍事威脅面前退縮，恐削弱美國威懾力。
巴加埃並澄清，外長阿拉格齊當天是前往參與朝聖活動，並非赴外會談，伊朗所有談判人員仍留在國內。
巴加埃指出，伊朗目前在進行的對話對象是阿曼，議題聚焦於荷姆茲海峽的航行安全，雙方希望儘速就一條臨時安全航道達成共識，讓船隻得以恢復通行。
他強調，這純粹是伊朗與阿曼之間的雙邊事務，其他國家或勢力介入與否，都不會改變這項談判的性質。
至於外界關注的海峽現狀，巴加埃警告，只要美方持續採取挑釁行動並維持海上封鎖，情勢就難有實質改變。
根據伊朗《法爾斯通訊社》報導，就在同一天，伊朗革命衛隊宣布在荷姆茲海峽上空擊落一架美製 MQ-9 無人機。
這場外交羅生門的背景，是川普週六（1 日）的公開表態。他當時宣稱已取消原訂的大規模軍事打擊計畫，改為爭取儘快與伊朗達成協議，藉此化解核武疑慮並重新打通荷姆茲海峽的航運。
然而，《CNN》3 日獨家引述消息人士指出，美軍中央司令部一名情報官員上週三透過電子郵件，向軍事分析師徵詢對伊朗施壓與懲罰的「新穎且非傳統」構想，顯示五角大廈內部正在就下一步行動集思廣益。
消息人士形容，這種以電子郵件公開徵求意見的作法相當罕見，某種程度反映出川普政府想在其開出的條件下迫使伊朗讓步，但可用選項其實相當有限。
中央司令部發言人霍金斯回應時則將此舉定調為單位一貫的創新文化，稱司令庫珀向來樂於傾聽團隊中各階層成員的意見，以追求最佳作戰成效。
報導並提到，川普陣營內部也在評估升高軍事行動的可能性，包括是否重啟對伊朗殘餘核設施的打擊。但消息人士坦言，由於相關設施深埋地下，單靠飛彈與炸彈恐怕難以造成決定性破壞。
另一個選項則是象徵性較強、規模有限的「表演式」打擊，鎖定過去曾攻擊過的類似目標，讓川普得以宣稱勝利並藉機收手，而不必真正達成徹底清除伊朗核計畫的原始目標。
報導同時指出，無論採取何種軍事手段，恐怕都無法解決衝突核心，即伊朗對荷姆茲海峽的實質掌控權。
消息人士指出：「追根究底，總統（川普）還是想達成協議的，所以他會不斷尋找強硬應對並從中脫身的方法。有時候你需要富有創造力的頭腦，尤其是在常規選項即將耗盡的時候。」
《華爾街日報》3 日的分析則認為，川普在連日威脅對伊朗發動新一輪攻勢後，如今又轉向外交手段，顯示他仍希望以談判取得軍事行動未能完成的目標。
報導認為，關鍵在於美國的波灣盟友能否在短時間內取得實質進展，至少讓荷姆茲海峽恢復部分通航，為後續核談判鋪路；但若協商再度陷入僵局，川普可能重演過去的模式，先擱置軍事威脅，再伺機重新祭出。
伊朗《邁赫爾通訊社》則以較強硬的語氣評論指出，這已是川普第十次在對德黑蘭祭出「決定性」軍事威脅後選擇退讓，認為美方一再的猶豫不僅削弱了自身的威懾力，也讓區域內盟友與對手重新評估各方真實的實力對比。
分析指出，伊朗議題如今已不只是外交層面的角力，更牽動川普的內政與戰略處境，若持續維持現行策略而不做調整，恐讓白宮陷入更難脫身的困境。
paras_en: Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson, Bahram Ghasemi, rejected US President Donald Trump's claims of negotiations between the two countries, stating that Tehran is not engaged in any form of talks with Washington. He also denied reports of a planned meeting between the two sides.

Ghasemi clarified that Foreign Minister Mohammad Javad Zarif was in the country for a pilgrimage and not for a meeting with the US. He emphasized that all Iranian negotiators are still in the country.

Ghasemi stated that Iran is currently engaged in talks with Oman, focusing on the safety of navigation in the Hormuz Strait. The two sides aim to reach an agreement on a temporary safety corridor as soon as possible, allowing ships to resume passage.
He stressed that this is a bilateral issue between Iran and Oman, and that the nature of the talks will not be changed by the involvement of other countries or powers.
Regarding the current situation in the strait, Ghasemi warned that as long as the US continues to take provocative actions and maintains a naval blockade, the situation will not improve.
According to a report by Iran's Fars News Agency, the Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps announced that it had shot down a US-made MQ-9 drone in the Hormuz Strait on the same day.

The background to this diplomatic standoff is Trump's public statement on Saturday, in which he claimed to have canceled a planned large-scale military strike and instead sought to reach an agreement with Iran to resolve nuclear concerns and reopen the Hormuz Strait to shipping.

However, a CNN exclusive on Monday quoted sources as saying that a US military intelligence officer had emailed a military analyst on Tuesday, seeking innovative and non-traditional ideas for pressuring and punishing Iran.
The sources described this as an unusual move, reflecting the Trump administration's desire to force Iran to make concessions under its conditions, but with limited options available.

The US Central Command spokesperson, Colonel John Thomas, responded by downplaying the move as a routine part of the unit's innovative culture, saying that Commander Kenneth McKenzie has always encouraged team members to share their ideas to achieve the best possible operational outcomes.

The report also noted that the Trump administration is evaluating the possibility of escalating military action, including restarting attacks on Iran's remaining nuclear facilities. However, sources acknowledged that the facilities are deeply buried underground, making it difficult to achieve a decisive blow with missiles and bombs.

Another option is a symbolic and limited 'showcase' attack targeting similar past targets, allowing Trump to claim victory and withdraw without achieving the original goal of completely eliminating Iran's nuclear program.
The report concluded that any military action would likely fail to address the core issue of Iran's control over the Hormuz Strait.
A source said, 'Ultimately, the president still wants to reach an agreement, so he will continue to look for ways to respond strongly and then get out of it.'
The Wall Street Journal's analysis on Monday noted that Trump's shift from threats to diplomacy shows that he still hopes to achieve his military goals through negotiations.

The report emphasized that the key to success lies in the US's Gulf allies making tangible progress in a short period, at least allowing for partial navigation of the Hormuz Strait and paving the way for future nuclear talks. However, if negotiations stall again, Trump may repeat his past pattern of postponing military threats and waiting for an opportunity to re-deploy them.

Iran's Mehr News Agency took a harder line, stating that this is Trump's tenth time threatening Iran with 'decisive' military action before backing down, and that the US's repeated hesitation has weakened its deterrent power and led regional allies and adversaries to reassess the balance of power.

The analysis concluded that the Iran issue has become more than just a diplomatic standoff, but also involves Trump's domestic and strategic situation. If the US continues to maintain its current strategy without adjustment, it may lead the White House into an even more difficult situation.

items.title: 財經名嘴：華爾街最新「籃子交易」正創造逢低布局機會
items.title_en: CNBC's Jim Cramer: Wall Street's 'Basket Trades' Are Creating Buying Opportunities
paras: 《CNBC》財經節目主持人 Jim Cramer 周一 (3 日) 表示，華爾街近期盛行的「籃子交易(Basket Trades)」正在扭曲許多股票的價格表現，投資人反而可以利用這些錯價尋找布局機會。
Cramer 在節目中談到，「最棒的事？就是這些交易創造了真正的投資機會。在公司公布財報前，股價往往會脫離基本面。」
「當市場以籃子交易形成的估值，遇上真正的財報表現時，就有機會帶來可觀的獲利。」
Cramer 指出，交易員愈來愈傾向依照特定主題將股票歸類成不同「籃子」，使同一類股票同步上漲或下跌，而不是根據各家公司本身的基本面來決定股價。
他表示，這類交易方式尤其在中東衝突持續期間主導每日走勢，但很多時候與企業長期前景並沒有太大關聯。
Cramer 以波音 (Boeing)(BA-US) 為例指出，近期波音股價愈來愈受到中東地緣政治消息影響。當市場看到外交談判取得進展時，波音股價便上漲，若衝突升溫，股價則同步下跌。但他認為，這些每日新聞並不會改變波音長期的投資價值。
Cramer 表示，「真正決定波音價值的，是現金流與飛機生產能力，而不是把波音當成交易工具。」他指出，波音目前握有約 6,200 架飛機的積壓訂單，這遠比中東局勢短期變化更值得投資人關注。

根據 Cramer，零售股近期也成為典型的籃子交易。當中東局勢緊張、油價走高引發市場對通膨的擔憂時，投資人開始轉向好市多 (Costco)(COST-US) 與沃爾瑪 (Walmart)(WMT-US)，因市場認為，在消費者因油價上漲而縮減支出時，這兩家公司將是受惠者，同時賣出 Ralph Lauren(RL-US)、Target(TGT-US) 及 Williams-Sonoma(WSM-US)等偏非必須性消費的零售股。
他表示，「好市多和沃爾瑪都是優秀、能夠長期持有的零售企業。無論戰爭情勢如何，它們都值得投資。」
Cramer 指出，今年上半年，科技股成為華爾街最熱門籃子交易之一。市場普遍追捧 AI 基礎設施相關股票，同時大舉賣出企業軟體公司，而不論各家公司本身的營運表現如何。
他表示，市場普遍認為，AI 熱潮最大的受惠者將是硬體供應商，而企業軟體業者則可能因 AI 衝擊傳統按席位收費模式而面臨壓力。不過，隨著這股交易趨勢開始反轉，基本面較佳的企業開始脫穎而出。ServiceNow(NOW-US) 與 Salesforce(CRM-US) 等公司已逐漸擺脫整體軟體族群同步波動的影響，開始反映自身基本面的價值。
Cramer 坦言，短期內，籃子交易確實可能壓過企業基本面，主導股價走勢。但他認為，每逢財報季，市場最終仍會重新把焦點放回各家公司本身的營運表現。
他談到，「很高興看到基本面終究還是重要的，即使這種情況一年只有四次，在財報季時才會發生。」
paras_en: CNBC's Jim Cramer said on Monday that Wall Street's recent 'basket trades' are distorting the price performance of many stocks, but investors can use these mispricings to find buying opportunities.
Cramer said, 'The best thing is that these trades are creating real investment opportunities. Before companies report their earnings, stock prices tend to diverge from their fundamental value.'
He added, 'When the market's valuation based on basket trades meets the actual earnings performance, it can lead to significant profits.'

Cramer pointed out that traders are increasingly inclined to categorize stocks into different 'baskets' based on specific themes, causing stocks in the same category to move in tandem, rather than being determined by each company's fundamental value.
He noted that this type of trading is particularly prevalent during periods of Middle East conflict, but often has little to do with the long-term prospects of the companies involved.

Cramer used Boeing (BA-US) as an example, saying that the company's stock price has been increasingly influenced by Middle East geopolitical news. When diplomatic talks progress, Boeing's stock price rises, and when tensions escalate, it falls. However, he believes that these daily news events will not change Boeing's long-term investment value.

Cramer said, 'What really determines Boeing's value is its cash flow and aircraft production capacity, not treating Boeing as a trading tool.' He noted that Boeing currently has about 6,200 aircraft on order, which is a much more significant factor for investors to consider than short-term changes in Middle East tensions.

According to Cramer, retail stocks have also become a typical example of basket trading. When Middle East tensions are high and oil prices rise, investors start to shift towards Costco (COST-US) and Walmart (WMT-US), which are seen as beneficiaries in a scenario where consumers reduce spending due to higher oil prices.
He said, 'Costco and Walmart are excellent, long-term retail companies. Regardless of the war situation, they are worth investing in.'

Cramer pointed out that in the first half of this year, tech stocks became one of the most popular basket trades on Wall Street. The market widely chased AI infrastructure-related stocks while selling off enterprise software companies, regardless of their individual operating performance.

He said, 'The market widely believes that the AI trend will benefit hardware suppliers, while enterprise software companies may face pressure due to the disruption of traditional per-seat pricing models.' However, as this trading trend begins to reverse, companies with better fundamentals are starting to emerge.

ServiceNow (NOW-US) and Salesforce (CRM-US) are examples of companies that have gradually escaped the influence of the overall software sector's volatility and are starting to reflect their own fundamental values.

Cramer said, 'In the short term, basket trades may indeed overpower company fundamentals and drive stock prices. However, he believes that every time earnings season comes around, the market will eventually refocus on the operating performance of individual companies.'
He said, 'It's great to see that fundamentals still matter, even if it only happens four times a year during earnings season.'

items.title: 日本本輪救匯狂砸11兆日元 接近歷史最大規模
items.title_en: Japan's Intervention Brings 11 Trillion Yen to Market, Approaching Historic Scale
paras: 本周一（3 日）晚間的消息顯示，根據日本央行的貨幣市場數據推算，上周四、周五的外匯干預中可能又動用了超過等值 11 兆日元的銀彈。
作為背景，日本在 4 月至 5 月期間的那一輪外匯干預中，共動用價值近 11.73 兆日元（約 736 億美元）的資金，創日本干預外匯市場單月規模新高。
日本央行的最新數據顯示，基於上周五政府部門的交易，金融體系將於周二面臨 11.4 兆日元的流動性流出。金融交易通常在兩個工作日後結算。貨幣經紀商此前預期的流出規模約 6 兆日元，多出來的 5 兆很有可能就是日本當局干預匯市的規模。
此前測算顯示，日本當局在上周四可能動用美元購入 6 至 7 兆日元。這意味著這一輪外匯干預很有可能接近甚至超越三個月前的紀錄。
日本財務大臣片山皋月周一早些時候發布聲明，證實日本和美國在上周五聯合干預匯市，以應對日元近期「過度波動和無序走勢」。她表示，將毫不猶豫採取進一步行動。
美國財長貝森特也在社交媒體發帖證實了這一行動，並表示「美國將毫不猶豫參與進一步聯合干預」。
作為本次干預的短線效果，日元匯率從上周四最低時的 1 美元兌 164 日元，到周一早盤時段曾觸及 1 美元兌 155.2 日元。
值得一提的是，在 4 月至 5 月的干預中，日元匯率也一度從 160 快速升至 155 區間。但由於日本貨幣的結構性弱勢（日美利差、油價上漲和美國聯準會升息預期），那一輪砸下 700 多億美元的效果僅維持了一個多月。
考慮到這些打壓日元的因素依然存在，即便美國罕見出手聯合干預日元，日元漲勢能維持多久依然面臨較大不確定性。
paras_en: According to data from the Bank of Japan, the country's currency market intervention on Thursday and Friday may have used more than ¥11 trillion in foreign exchange reserves.

In the context of the previous intervention in April and May, Japan used approximately ¥11.73 trillion (around $736 billion) in funds, setting a new record for the largest monthly intervention in the country's history.

The Bank of Japan's latest data shows that, based on government transactions on Friday, the financial system will face a liquidity outflow of ¥11.4 trillion on Tuesday. Financial transactions are typically settled two business days later.
Currency brokers had previously estimated a liquidity outflow of around ¥6 trillion, with the additional ¥5 trillion likely to be the scale of Japan's intervention in the foreign exchange market.

Previous estimates suggested that Japan may have used ¥6 to ¥7 trillion to purchase US dollars on Thursday, indicating that this round of intervention may be approaching or even surpassing the record set three months ago.

Japanese Finance Minister Shunichi Suzuki released a statement on Monday morning, confirming that Japan and the US had jointly intervened in the foreign exchange market on Friday to address the yen's recent 'excessive volatility and disorderly movement'.
He stated that Japan would take further action without hesitation.
US Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen also confirmed the action on social media, stating that 'the US will participate in further joint intervention without hesitation'.
As a short-term effect of the intervention, the yen's exchange rate rose from a low of 164 yen per dollar on Thursday to a high of 155.2 yen per dollar on Monday morning.

It's worth noting that the yen's exchange rate also rose from 160 to 155 in the previous intervention in April and May, but the effect was short-lived due to Japan's structural currency weakness (yen-dollar interest rate differential, rising oil prices, and expectations of a US Federal Reserve rate hike).
That intervention, which used over $700 billion, only lasted for a month.
Considering that these factors are still in place, even with the rare joint intervention by the US, the sustainability of the yen's rally remains uncertain.

items.title: Hugging Face執行長：中國AI靠開放權重模型領先　年底或反超美國
items.title_en: Hugging Face CEO: China Leads in Open-Weight AI Models and May Overtake the U.S. by Year-End
paras: 全球最大開放式 AI 平台 Hugging Face 共同創辦人兼執行長 Clément Delangue 周一 (3 日) 說，中國已在 AI 競賽中取得領先，尤其在「開放權重」模型領域佔據主導地位，按當前速度，今年底或明年就可能在先進模型領域反超美國。
Delangue 解釋，開放權重模型公開訓練後的參數檔，允許公眾下載、修改與自託管運行，但不揭露原始訓練資料與訓練程式碼，層級低於完全開源 (Open Source)。中國業者憑藉開放協作與共享生態，讓技術迭代遠快於美國；反觀美國實驗室各自為戰、封閉發展，正面臨掉隊風險。
Delangue 還提到上月 OpenAI 智能體逃離沙盒、入侵 Hugging Face 事件，歸因於工程實作失誤，而非開放模型之過，Hugging Face 最終靠「輝達二次分發版本的中國開源模型」在自有算力上完成取證防禦。
他並強調，閉源 API 的安全護欄反讓防禦方綁手綁腳，開放模型可審計、可私有部署，才是 AI 網安主戰場的防禦主力。
Delangue 也發聲反對美國限制境內使用中國開放權重模型，稱此舉等同「自廢武功」。
全球開源 AI 社群掌門人此番發言之際，正值華府辯論是否管制開放權重模型之際，凸顯中國在大模型開放生態的話語權已實質威脅美國閉源陣營。
paras_en: Clement Delangue, co‑founder and CEO of Hugging Face, the world’s largest open AI platform, said on Monday (the 3rd) that China has taken the lead in the AI race, especially dominating the field of “open‑weight” models, and at the current pace could surpass the United States in advanced models by the end of this year or next year.

Delangue explained that open‑weight models release the trained parameter files for public download, modification, and self‑hosting, but do not disclose the original training data or training code, placing them a step below fully open‑source software. Chinese firms, he said, benefit from an open‑collaboration and sharing ecosystem that lets technology iterate far faster than in the United States, where labs tend to work in isolation with closed development, putting them at risk of falling behind.

He also referenced last month’s incident in which an OpenAI agent escaped its sandbox and intruded on Hugging Face, attributing the breach to engineering mistakes rather than any fault of the open model itself. Hugging Face ultimately defended itself by using a “NVIDIA‑re‑distributed Chinese open‑source model” on its own compute resources to verify the attack.

Delangue emphasized that the safety barriers of closed‑source APIs actually hinder defenders, whereas open models can be audited and privately deployed, making them the main line of defense in AI cybersecurity.
He also voiced opposition to U.S. restrictions on the domestic use of Chinese open‑weight models, calling such measures a case of “self‑inflicted loss of capability.”

The remarks from the global open‑source AI community leader come as Washington debates whether to regulate open‑weight models, highlighting that China’s influence in the large‑model open ecosystem now poses a tangible challenge to the U.S. closed‑source camp.

items.title: AI Agents將引爆下一波資本支出？國際機構：AI基礎建設仍是最大贏家
items.title_en: AI Agents to Trigger Next Wave of Capital Expenditure? International Institutions: AI Infrastructure Remains the Biggest Winner
paras: 2026年08月04日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI投資主軸正從大型語言模型（LLM）訓練，逐步延伸至具自主決策能力的AI Agents。多位國際投資機構認為，隨著科技巨頭持續擴大資料中心資本支出，AI Agents將成為下一波AI基礎建設需求的重要驅動力，半導體、AI伺服器、電源、網通及資料中心等供應鏈，可望持續受惠。
在日本金融集團MUFG旗下Krungsri舉辦的投資論壇中，Siametrics Consulting創辦人兼執行長Dr. Napat Jatusripitak表示，AI正由聊天機器人（Chatbot）邁向AI Agents，不再只是回答問題或生成內容，而是具備自主規劃、決策及跨系統執行任務的能力，可望成為提升企業生產力的重要工具。
他認為，AI更可能改變工作的內容，而非全面取代人力。重複性工作將逐步交由AI完成，人類則可專注於分析、決策及創新等高附加價值工作。隨著企業導入AI Agents的範圍持續擴大，AI也將由生產力工具，逐步成為企業數位轉型的重要基礎設施。

全球經濟放緩非衰退 AI仍是核心投資主軸
Invesco亞太區（日本除外）全球市場策略分析師David Chao表示，全球經濟下半年仍將受到中東局勢、能源價格及地緣政治等因素干擾，但目前較可能只是成長放緩，而非步入衰退。
他認為，目前市場高估聯準會維持高利率的時間，若通膨持續降溫，聯準會仍有機會恢復降息。在此背景下，全球股市仍具投資價值，其中AI仍是未來數年的主要投資主題。
David Chao指出，科技巨頭持續加碼資料中心及AI基礎建設投資，因此半導體、AI伺服器、硬體設備及AI基礎建設等供應鏈，受惠程度可望高於純軟體公司。此外，在美元走弱帶動下，台灣、南韓及中國等AI供應鏈完整的新興市場，也可望持續吸引資金流入。

AI投資機會擴大至整個供應鏈
Invesco資深客戶投資組合經理Hal Clark表示，AI目前仍處於成長初期，投資機會不再侷限於大型科技股，而是擴及整個AI價值鏈，包括半導體、雲端服務、資料中心、AI模型開發，以及導入AI提升營運效率的企業。
他指出，隨著全球科技大廠持續增加AI基礎建設投資，未來市場焦點將由少數大型科技公司，逐步擴大至整體AI供應鏈與企業應用，AI Agents可望成為推動下一波資本支出的重要驅動力。

paras_en: On August 4, 2026, international investment institutions believe that as tech giants continue to expand their data center capital expenditures, AI Agents will become a key driver of the next wave of AI infrastructure demand, benefiting the semiconductor, AI server, power supply, network communication, and data center supply chains.

Dr. Napat Jatusripitak, founder and CEO of Siametrics Consulting, stated at an investment forum hosted by Krungsri under Japan's MUFG, that AI is transitioning from chatbots to AI Agents, which will have autonomous planning, decision-making, and cross-system task execution capabilities, and is expected to become an important tool for boosting corporate productivity.

He believes that AI is more likely to change the nature of work rather than completely replacing human labor, with repetitive tasks being gradually taken over by AI, allowing humans to focus on high-value work such as analysis, decision-making, and innovation. As companies expand their adoption of AI Agents, AI will become a key infrastructure for enterprise digital transformation.

David Chao, a global market strategy analyst at Invesco for the Asia-Pacific region (excluding Japan), stated that while the global economy will continue to be affected by factors such as the Middle East situation, energy prices, and geopolitics in the second half of the year, it is more likely to experience a growth slowdown rather than a recession.

Chao believes that the market overestimates the duration of the Fed's high-interest rates, and if inflation continues to cool down, the Fed may still have the opportunity to cut interest rates. In this context, the global stock market still has investment value, with AI remaining a major investment theme for the next few years.

David Chao pointed out that as tech giants continue to invest in data centers and AI infrastructure, the semiconductor, AI server, hardware, and AI infrastructure supply chains will benefit more than pure software companies. Additionally, emerging markets such as Taiwan, South Korea, and China, which have a complete AI supply chain, are expected to continue attracting capital inflows due to a weaker US dollar.

Hal Clark, a senior client portfolio manager at Invesco, stated that AI investment opportunities are no longer limited to large tech stocks, but have expanded to the entire AI value chain, including semiconductors, cloud services, data centers, AI model development, and companies that adopt AI to improve operational efficiency.

items.title: 華府智庫CSIS：川普屢次未兌現打擊威脅 讓伊朗認為美國很軟弱
items.title_en: CSIS: Trump's Repeated Failure to Follow Through on Threats Makes Iran See the U.S. as Weak
paras: 美國智庫「戰略與國際問題研究中心 (CSIS)」中東項目主任 Mona Yacoubian 周一(3 日) 警告，川普政府多次對伊朗放出「最嚴厲威脅」卻未在最後關頭兌現打擊行動，已讓德黑蘭解讀為「美國軟弱」，並自認在美伊衝突中佔據上風。
她說：「每次他這樣做，伊朗接收到的訊號就是：美國很軟弱，伊朗佔了上風。」
Yacoubian 也整理出當前的「軍事升級→宣布外交突破卻落空→重回相互威脅」的循環模式。
她認為，這種「狼來了」式的操作削弱華府威懾可信度，也讓伊朗更有底氣拖過選舉週期與彈藥消耗期。
Yacoubian 還指出，美國最近一次暫緩打擊，關鍵變數在波斯灣盟友——沙特、阿聯、卡達擔心伊朗會毫不猶豫報復區域基礎設施與能源樞紐，把霍爾木茲風險一次性引爆，因此向白宮施壓踩剎車。
分析指出，特朗普「極限施壓＋臨陣回縮」的談判術，用於商業博弈或尚可，但面對承受痛苦門檻更高的伊朗政體，反襯出華府軍事選項的政治成本：中期選舉將近、油價敏感、彈藥庫存下滑。伊朗則借機把「美國不敢打」內化為心理優勢，在核談判、海峽通行與代理人戰線上同步抬價。
市場與外交圈解讀，若威懾可信度持續流失，下階段風險不在「美國打多大」，而在「伊朗先手多狠」——從無人機騷擾到能源設施靶向攻擊，區域火藥味只會更濃。
paras_en: Mona Yacoubian, director of the Middle East program at the U.S. think tank Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS), warned on Monday (the 3rd) that the Trump administration’s repeated issuance of "the harshest threats" toward Iran without actually carrying out strikes at the last moment has led Tehran to interpret this as "U.S. weakness" and to believe it holds the upper hand in any U.S.-Iran confrontation.
She said, "Every time he does this, the signal Iran receives is: the United States is weak, and Iran has the advantage."
Yacoubian also outlined the current cycle of "military escalation → announced diplomatic breakthrough that falls flat → back to mutual threats."
She believes this "boy‑who‑cried‑wolf" approach erodes the credibility of Washington’s deterrence and gives Iran more confidence to ride out an election cycle and a period of ammunition consumption.

Yacoubian further noted that the most recent U.S. pause on strikes was driven by concerns from Gulf allies—Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Qatar—that Iran might retaliate without hesitation against regional infrastructure and energy hubs, potentially igniting a one‑off crisis in the Strait of Hormuz, prompting them to pressure the White House to hit the brakes.

Analysts say Trump’s “maximum pressure plus last‑minute retreat” negotiating style might work in commercial games, but against an Iranian regime with a higher pain threshold it highlights the political cost of U.S. military options: a looming midterm election, oil‑price sensitivity, and dwindling ammunition stockpiles. Iran, meanwhile, is turning the perception that "the U.S. won’t dare to strike" into a psychological advantage, raising its demands simultaneously in nuclear talks, Strait navigation and proxy‑war fronts.

Market observers and diplomats interpret that if deterrence credibility continues to erode, the next risk is not how big a U.S. strike could be, but how aggressively Iran might act first—ranging from drone harassment to targeted attacks on energy facilities—making the regional powder keg even more volatile.

items.title: 日本本輪救匯狂砸11兆日元 接近歷史最大規模
items.title_en: Japan's Intervention Brings 11 Trillion Yen to Market, Approaching Historic Scale
paras: 本周一（3 日）晚間的消息顯示，根據日本央行的貨幣市場數據推算，上周四、周五的外匯干預中可能又動用了超過等值 11 兆日元的銀彈。
作為背景，日本在 4 月至 5 月期間的那一輪外匯干預中，共動用價值近 11.73 兆日元（約 736 億美元）的資金，創日本干預外匯市場單月規模新高。
日本央行的最新數據顯示，基於上周五政府部門的交易，金融體系將於周二面臨 11.4 兆日元的流動性流出。金融交易通常在兩個工作日後結算。貨幣經紀商此前預期的流出規模約 6 兆日元，多出來的 5 兆很有可能就是日本當局干預匯市的規模。
此前測算顯示，日本當局在上周四可能動用美元購入 6 至 7 兆日元。這意味著這一輪外匯干預很有可能接近甚至超越三個月前的紀錄。
日本財務大臣片山皋月周一早些時候發布聲明，證實日本和美國在上周五聯合干預匯市，以應對日元近期「過度波動和無序走勢」。她表示，將毫不猶豫採取進一步行動。
美國財長貝森特也在社交媒體發帖證實了這一行動，並表示「美國將毫不猶豫參與進一步聯合干預」。
作為本次干預的短線效果，日元匯率從上周四最低時的 1 美元兌 164 日元，到周一早盤時段曾觸及 1 美元兌 155.2 日元。
值得一提的是，在 4 月至 5 月的干預中，日元匯率也一度從 160 快速升至 155 區間。但由於日本貨幣的結構性弱勢（日美利差、油價上漲和美國聯準會升息預期），那一輪砸下 700 多億美元的效果僅維持了一個多月。
考慮到這些打壓日元的因素依然存在，即便美國罕見出手聯合干預日元，日元漲勢能維持多久依然面臨較大不確定性。
paras_en: According to data from the Bank of Japan, the country's currency market intervention on Thursday and Friday may have used more than ¥11 trillion in foreign exchange reserves.

In the context of the previous intervention in April and May, Japan used approximately ¥11.73 trillion (around $736 billion) in funds, setting a new record for the largest monthly intervention in the country's history.

The Bank of Japan's latest data shows that, based on government transactions on Friday, the financial system will face a liquidity outflow of ¥11.4 trillion on Tuesday. Financial transactions are typically settled two business days later.
Currency brokers had previously estimated a liquidity outflow of around ¥6 trillion, with the additional ¥5 trillion likely to be the scale of Japan's intervention in the foreign exchange market.

Previous estimates suggested that Japan may have used ¥6 to ¥7 trillion to purchase US dollars on Thursday, indicating that this round of intervention may be approaching or even surpassing the record set three months ago.

Japanese Finance Minister Shunichi Suzuki released a statement on Monday morning, confirming that Japan and the US had jointly intervened in the foreign exchange market on Friday to address the yen's recent 'excessive volatility and disorderly movement'.
He stated that Japan would take further action without hesitation.
US Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen also confirmed the action on social media, stating that 'the US will participate in further joint intervention without hesitation'.
As a short-term effect of the intervention, the yen's exchange rate rose from a low of 164 yen per dollar on Thursday to a high of 155.2 yen per dollar on Monday morning.

It's worth noting that the yen's exchange rate also rose from 160 to 155 in the previous intervention in April and May, but the effect was short-lived due to Japan's structural currency weakness (yen-dollar interest rate differential, rising oil prices, and expectations of a US Federal Reserve rate hike).
That intervention, which used over $700 billion, only lasted for a month.
Considering that these factors are still in place, even with the rare joint intervention by the US, the sustainability of the yen's rally remains uncertain.

隨後紐約聯邦儲備銀行總裁威廉姆斯表示，仍樂觀認為通貨膨脹壓力正朝著逐步緩解的方向發展，認為目前利率處於適宜位置，並據美國商務部公布 6 月建築支出意外跌 0.1%，突顯抵押貸款利率上升對房屋建設構成壓力，但 S&P 全球 7 月製造業 PMI 終值升至 53.9，而且美國供應管理協會 (ISM) 調查 7 月製造業 PMI 飆升至 2022 年 5 月以來最高 55.6，突顯訂單強勁增長帶動工廠產能增加及中東衝突擾亂供應鏈及持續推高投入成本，推動美元兌日圓收復大部分失地。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於 157.50-70，支撐於 156.30-50。
◆EUR/USD

美國總統川普週一將與伊朗舉行會談，期望迅速達成協議，重啟荷姆茲海峽及解決圍繞伊朗核能力僵局，重燃達成和平協議希望，改善風險偏好，並猜測日本再出手干預外匯市場提振日圓，但昨日 RatingDog/S&P 全球聯合公布中國 7 月製造業 PMI 降至四個月低點 50.9，令澳幣和紐元承壓，而且英國金融時報報導，美國財政部上週五與日本的協調行動支撐日圓，並非賣出美元，而是賣歐元，拖累歐元兌美元受限於 1.1558 高點。

據 S&P 全球 7 月製造業 PMI 調查，法國意外萎縮達 49.8，德國則重回四年高點 52.2，歐元區亦上揚至 51.9，創 4 月以來最高，但德國 6 月實質零售銷售較前月減少 1.1% 超過預期，而且歐洲央行 (ECB) 發表一篇經濟公報文章稱，伊朗戰爭爆發後消費者信心大幅下滑，歐元區家庭消費明顯萎縮，若衝突再升級，消費者支出可能再受抑制，打壓歐元兌美元至 1.1499 低點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於 1.1520-40，支撐於 1.1440-60。
◆GBP/USD

週一會計師事務所安永分析師警告稱，若荷姆茲海峽在明年年中前仍未恢復通航，英國經濟明年可能萎縮，而且招聘平台 Indeed 調查今年上半年英國招聘活動減少，面向應屆畢業生職位空缺降至 2020 年以來最低，打擊英鎊兌美元自 1.3506 高點走低。隨著 S&P 全球英國 7 月製造業 PMI 連續九個月擴張達 51.9，但增速為四個月最低，擴大英鎊兌美元跌幅至 1.3414 低點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於 1.3430-50，支撐於 1.3340-60。

items.title: 日元急升近5%只是曇花一現？ 美日聯手救匯率仍難敵利差 市場看衰日元長線走勢
items.title_en: Yen's 5% Surge May Be Just a Fleeting Moment: Joint Intervention Fails to Overcome Interest Rate Gap
paras: 美國與日本近日聯手干預外匯市場，推動日元自 40 年低點大幅反彈，單週升值近 5%，但市場普遍認為，在美日利率差距依舊懸殊、日本央行尚未採取進一步緊縮政策下，此次規模空前的干預行動恐怕只能暫時穩定匯市，難以從根本扭轉日元長期弱勢。
根據先前報導，美國總統川普在內閣會議中證實，美方參與此次聯合干預行動，並形容此舉是「友誼的信號」。
日本財務省隨後正式確認，已與美國財政部共同進場干預匯市，使日元自上週觸及的 40 年低點、每美元兌 164 日元，回升至 156.8 日元，單週升值幅度接近 5%。市場估計，本次干預規模超過 500 億美元。
不過，市場對此次干預反應相對冷淡。儘管日元短線急升，但匯價僅回到今年 5 月附近水準，年初至今兌美元升幅幾乎歸零。相較之下，2024 年日本銀行單獨干預匯市時，曾成功將日元由 161 升至 141，累計升值約 12%，此次反彈力道明顯較弱。
多位外匯策略師及經濟學家指出，只要美日利差維持高檔，任何官方干預都只能延緩跌勢，而無法改變日元疲弱的基本面。
此次聯合干預也被視為美日歷來規模最大的協同行動之一。有媒體拍攝到美國財政部長 Scott Bessent 桌上的待辦事項，其中寫有「買入日元 50 至 100 億美元」。另據《金融時報》引述知情人士報導，紐約聯邦準備銀行此次透過出售歐元、買入日元的方式參與市場操作。
值得注意的是，日本過去進場干預時，多半透過出售持有、規模約 1.1 兆美元的美國公債籌措資金。然而，目前 30 年期美國公債殖利率接近 20 年高點，大規模出售美債可能進一步推升殖利率，因此也限制了日本的操作空間。
此次干預也帶來另一項市場效應，美元指數跌破 100，為今年 6 月以來首見。在正式干預之前，Scott Bessent 與日本財務大臣片山皋月皆曾透過公開喊話試圖提振日元，但效果有限，最終促使雙方採取實際市場干預。
市場人士普遍認為，真正左右日元走勢的仍是利率差距，而非短期官方進場買盤。
Robin Brooks 表示，日元疲弱並非源於投機資金刻意做空，而是日本公債殖利率遠低於合理水準。他指出，資金自然流向報酬率較高的市場，才是日元持續承壓的根本原因。
目前日本政策利率僅 1%，而美國聯邦準備理事會聯邦基金利率目標區間則維持在 3.50% 至 3.75%，兩國利率仍存在明顯差距。
日本銀行上週召開政策會議後，決定維持利率不變，進一步強化市場對利差短期難以縮小的預期。
荷蘭國際集團經濟學家 Chris Turner 指出，日本央行若能在 9 月 18 日政策會議展現更明確的緊縮立場，仍有機會升息 1 碼 (25 個基點)。但他也強調，目前日本消費者物價指數 (CPI) 已接近 2%，政策利率卻只有約 1%，仍低於通膨水準，顯示日本貨幣政策依舊相對寬鬆。
Gavekal 執行長 Louis Gave 也持相同看法。他表示，除非聯準會開始降息，或日本銀行啟動升息循環，否則日元難以出現具持續性的升值走勢。他並認為，日元與其他東北亞貨幣一樣，目前均處於「嚴重低估」狀態，相關觀點也與德意志銀行 (DB-US) 7 月發布的《世界地圖》研究報告，以及《經濟學人》最新一期巨無霸指數分析相互呼應。
從基本面來看，日本擁有七國集團 (G7) 中最大的經常帳順差，理論上有利於支撐本國貨幣。不過，過去 15 年間盛行的日元套利交易 (carry trade)，即投資人借入低利率日元，再投資高收益資產，持續削弱日元需求，使基本面優勢未能有效反映在匯率表現上。
分析人士認為，只要日本銀行未能在貨幣政策上採取更積極行動，美日此次聯手干預的效果恐將隨時間逐漸消退，在利差與套利交易持續存在的情況下，日元結構性的弱勢格局短期內仍難出現根本性改變。
paras_en: The US and Japan have recently joined forces to intervene in the foreign exchange market, driving the yen to a significant rebound from its 40-year low, with a weekly gain of nearly 5%. However, the market is generally skeptical that this unprecedented intervention will be able to fundamentally reverse the yen's long-term weakness.
According to previous reports, US President Trump confirmed that the US participated in the joint intervention, describing it as a 'signal of friendship'.

The Japanese Ministry of Finance has since officially confirmed that it has joined forces with the US Department of the Treasury to intervene in the market, causing the yen to rise from its 40-year low of 164 yen per dollar to 156.8 yen, with a weekly gain of nearly 5%. The market estimates that the intervention scale exceeded $500 billion.

However, the market's response to this intervention has been relatively lukewarm. Although the yen has surged in the short term, the exchange rate has only returned to the level of May this year, and the year-to-date appreciation against the dollar has almost returned to zero. In comparison, the Japanese central bank's single-handed intervention in 2024 successfully raised the yen from 161 to 141, with a cumulative appreciation of around 12%, this time the rebound is significantly weaker.

Several foreign exchange strategists and economists point out that as long as the US-Japan interest rate gap remains high, any official intervention will only delay the decline, but will not change the yen's fundamental weakness.

This joint intervention is also seen as one of the largest cooperative actions between the US and Japan in history. Media outlets have captured a to-do list on US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's desk, which includes 'buying 50-100 billion yen'. According to a report by the Financial Times, the Federal Reserve Bank of New York participated in the market operation by selling euros and buying yen.

It's worth noting that Japan has previously intervened in the market by selling its holdings of US Treasury bonds, worth around $1.1 trillion. However, with the 30-year US Treasury bond yield approaching its 20-year high, large-scale sales of US bonds could further push up yields, limiting Japan's operational space.

This intervention has also brought another market effect, with the US dollar index falling below 100, a first since June this year. Before the formal intervention, Scott Bessent and Japanese Finance Minister Hiroshi Nagata had both used public statements to try to boost the yen, but with limited effect, ultimately prompting the two sides to take actual market intervention.
Market participants generally believe that the true driver of the yen's trend is still the interest rate gap, rather than the short-term official buying pool.

Robin Brooks notes that the yen's weakness is not due to speculative funds deliberately shorting the currency, but rather that Japan's bond yields are far lower than their reasonable level. He points out that funds naturally flow to markets with higher returns, which is the fundamental reason why the yen continues to be under pressure.

Currently, Japan's policy interest rate is only 1%, while the Federal Reserve's target range for the federal funds rate is 3.50-3.75%, with a significant gap between the two countries' interest rates.
The Bank of Japan last week held a policy meeting and decided to keep interest rates unchanged, further strengthening market expectations that the interest rate gap will not narrow in the short term.

Chris Turner, an economist at the Dutch International Group, notes that if the Bank of Japan can show a more clear tightening stance at the September 18 policy meeting, there is still a chance to raise interest rates by 1 point (25 basis points). However, he also emphasizes that Japan's consumer price index (CPI) is already near 2%, while the policy interest rate is only around 1%, still below the inflation level, indicating that Japan's monetary policy is still relatively loose.

Gavekal CEO Louis Gave also holds the same view. He notes that unless the Federal Reserve begins to lower interest rates or the Bank of Japan starts an interest rate hike cycle, the yen will find it difficult to show a sustained appreciation trend. He also believes that the yen, like other East Asian currencies, is currently in a 'severe undervaluation' state, which is consistent with the Deutsche Bank (DB-US) July report on the 'World Map' and the latest issue of the Economist's giant index analysis.

From a fundamental perspective, Japan has the largest current account surplus among the G7 countries, which should theoretically support its currency. However, the carry trade that has prevailed for the past 15 years, where investors borrow low-interest yen to invest in high-yielding assets, has continuously weakened yen demand, preventing the fundamental advantage from being effectively reflected in the exchange rate.

Analysts believe that as long as the Bank of Japan does not take more aggressive action in monetary policy, the effect of the US-Japan joint intervention will gradually fade over time, and in the presence of the interest rate gap and carry trade, the yen's structural weakness will remain difficult to change fundamentally in the short term.

items.title: USD/JPY：在日本與美國確認罕見的聯合干預後，日圓進一步反彈至155
items.title_en: USD/JPY: Yen Rallies Further to 155 After Rare Joint Intervention Confirmed by Japan and the U.S.
paras: 要點：

美元暴跌至 155.00 日圓
美國與日本聯手合作
波動性遊戲開始了？


這次美元兌日圓毫無招架之力。雙方都介入以協助掙扎中的日圓。

日圓獲得了一些支援


在日本和美國確認週五聯合買入日圓後，usdjpy 在週一跌至 155 附近。
該貨幣對週四曾高達 163.73，隨後在週五跌至 157.50。這真是一場政府贊助的情節大反轉。
這次行動是雙方自 2011 年以來的首次協調貨幣干預，也是自 1998 年以來首次透過直接購買來強化日圓的聯合行動。華盛頓通常讓東京自行捍衛其貨幣。
美國財政部長 Scott Bessent 表示，週五的協調行動反擊了「無序的日圓波動」。日本財務省也使用了類似的措辭，維持官方立場，即干預是針對過度波動，而不是特定的匯率。


紐約聯準會加入貨幣群聊


紐約聯邦準備銀行代表財政部採取行動，透過高盛和摩根士丹利賣出歐元並買入日圓。
歐洲央行官員也獲悉了這筆交易，這項不尋常的操作反映了華盛頓多麼重視該貨幣的無序下滑。
日本的干預過程通常從「匯率檢查」開始，日本央行會向交易員詢問目前的美元 / 日圓價格和交易規模。
這聽起來像是行政程序，但大致可以解讀為：官員們看到了這個水位，不喜歡它，並希望大家表現得識相點。
如果警告無效，日本財務省就會指示日本央行進入市場買入日圓，通常是透過賣出美元。週五的行動增加了美國的火力。隨著兩國政府購買同一種貨幣，押注日圓貶值的交易員突然面臨著財力異常雄厚的對手。


東京準備了更多彈藥


財務大臣 Satsuki Katayama 表示，日本將毫不猶豫地進行進一步的協調干預，並與美國財政部保持密切聯繫。
這將 160 至 164 日圓的區間從常規的圖表區域，變成了一個日圓空頭可能需要小心行事的地方。
干預措施已將美元 / 日圓匯率拉低至比週四高點低近 9 日圓的水準，但持久的成功仍取決於基本面。
日本的利率仍遠低於美國，干預很少能永久改寫這個等式。然而，它可以讓與之對抗的成本變得極其高昂。

paras_en:
Key points:

- The dollar plunged to ¥155.00
- U.S. and Japan coordinated action
- Is a volatility game starting?

The dollar‑yen pair was left defenseless this time. Both sides stepped in to aid a struggling yen.

The yen got some support.

After Japan and the United States confirmed a joint yen‑buying operation on Friday, USD/JPY fell to around 155 on Monday. The pair had peaked at 163.73 on Thursday before dropping to 157.50 on Friday. It was a government‑backed dramatic reversal.

This was the first coordinated currency intervention by the two countries since 2011 and the first joint direct‑purchase effort to bolster the yen since 1998. Washington usually lets Tokyo defend its own currency.

U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Friday’s coordinated action was a response to “disorderly yen volatility.” The Japanese Ministry of Finance used similar language, maintaining the official stance that the intervention targeted excessive volatility, not a specific exchange‑rate level.

New York Fed joins the currency chat.

A New York Federal Reserve Bank representative, acting on behalf of the Treasury, sold euros and bought yen through Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley.

European Central Bank officials were also informed of the trade, underscoring how seriously Washington views the yen’s disorderly decline.

Japan’s intervention process usually starts with a “rate check,” where the Bank of Japan asks dealers for the current USD/JPY price and trade size.

It sounds like a bureaucratic step, but essentially it means officials see the level, dislike it, and want market participants to behave.

If warnings fail, the Ministry of Finance instructs the BOJ to enter the market and buy yen, typically by selling dollars. Friday’s move added U.S. firepower. With both governments buying the same currency, traders betting on yen weakness suddenly faced a financially formidable opponent.

Tokyo is loading more ammunition.

Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said Japan will not hesitate to conduct further coordinated intervention and will stay in close contact with the U.S. Treasury.

This turns the ¥160‑¥164 band from a routine chart zone into an area where yen short sellers may need to tread carefully.

The intervention has pushed the USD/JPY rate down by nearly ¥9 from Thursday’s high, but lasting success still depends on fundamentals.

Japan’s rates remain far lower than U.S. rates, and intervention rarely rewrites that equation permanently. However, it can make the cost of opposing it extremely high.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元持平 美日聯手干預日元與油價回落削弱通膨憂慮
items.title_en: New York FX: Dollar Flat as US‑Japan Joint Yen Intervention and Falling Oil Prices Ease Inflation Concerns
paras: 美元周一 (3 日) 變動不大，市場持續消化聯準會 (Fed) 最新的貨幣政策決議、美日兩國證實聯手干預日元匯市，以及地緣政治緊張局勢降溫帶動油價下跌、進一步緩解近期的通膨疑慮。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數 (DXY) 持平於 99.90。
上周在聯準會宣布維持利率不變、並對未來貨幣政策路徑釋出不明朗訊號後，美元指數已下跌 1.5%。
受到美日兩國確認聯手干預日元匯市影響，美元兌日元承壓，下跌 0.3% 至 157.18，盤中一度跌至 155.23。
歐元兌美元下跌 0.2%，至 1 歐元兌 1.1508 美元。
市場同時關注油價走低，這有助於降低短期通膨壓力。這項趨勢也受到美國總統川普周末宣布的消息支持──美國將於今日與伊朗就荷姆茲海峽 (Strait of Hormuz) 航運及去核化議題展開談判，顯示中東局勢明顯降溫。
美國財政部長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 周日表示，美國堅定支持日本採取措施，糾正日元遭嚴重低估的情況，並明確警告，美國財政部將毫不猶豫參與未來任何進一步的聯合市場干預行動。
此次干預是數十年來美日首次聯手買進日元。在 7 月底日元兌美元一度跌破 162、創下 40 年新低後，兩國決定進場干預。
這次干預也為日元波動劇烈的 7 月畫下句點。最終日元 7 月兌美元升值 1.6%，創下去年 10 月以來最佳單月表現。市場干預，加上日本銀行 (BoJ) 釋出的鷹派訊號，引發大量空頭部位回補，推升日元走強。
市場也消化了日本銀行上周五公布的貨幣政策決議。日銀如市場預期，將基準利率維持在 1.0% 不變。
不過，日銀總裁植田和男 (Kazuo Ueda) 仍維持偏鷹立場。他警告，高能源進口成本可能推升通膨風險，並暗示央行仍準備在今年稍晚進一步升息。
整體外匯市場走勢，仍受到中東局勢發展影響。美國總統川普宣布，美國與伊朗官員將於周一恢復直接談判。
美國銀行全球研究部策略師指出，儘管市場因日本資金持續外流，以及高市早苗 (Sanae Takaichi) 政府政策風險等因素，對日元仍普遍抱持悲觀看法，但此次美日聯合干預具重大轉折意義。
美銀認為，美元兌日元 155 價位可能成為外匯市場的重要「轉折點」。策略師指出，今年稍早數次官方干預期間，美元兌日元都能在 155 附近獲得強力支撐，因此市場普遍認為官方干預效果有限。
然而，一旦匯價明確跌破 155，市場交易模式可能從「逢低買進美元」轉變為「反彈賣出美元」，企業避險需求所帶來的美元賣壓，也可能進一步加速此轉變。
美銀證券外匯與利率策略師 Shusuke Yamada 表示，「美國加入協同干預，提升市場對更廣泛政策架構的期待，目標是穩定日元匯率。」
他進一步補充，「由於美國參與，單方面耗盡外匯存底的限制實際上已經消除，因此投機資金要與官方對抗將變得更加困難。」
為降低出售美元可能對美國公債市場造成的影響，日本財務大臣與美國財長貝森特皆表示，將運用聯準會的「外國及國際貨幣當局附買回融資機制 (Foreign and International Monetary Authorities, FIMA)」提供流動性支援。
美銀也指出，此次聯合干預提高了市場對日銀加快升息步伐的預期，原本市場預估 10 月升息 1 碼，如今可能提前至 9 月實施。
另一方面，川普證實已取消原先規劃的軍事打擊行動，改以外交談判方式推動重新開放荷姆茲海峽，國際原油價格暴跌逾 4%，全球市場對能源推升通膨的短期憂慮也因此明顯降溫。
隨著地緣政治風險溢價略為消退，外匯市場接下來將把焦點轉向本周即將公布的一系列美國重要經濟數據，以研判聯準會 9 月的利率政策方向。其中最受關注的是一連串勞動市場數據，並將以 7 月非農就業報告作為壓軸焦點。

paras_en: The U.S. dollar changed little on Monday (the 3rd) as markets continued to digest the Fed’s latest monetary‑policy decision, the confirmed joint intervention by the United States and Japan in the yen market, and the cooling of geopolitical tensions that pushed oil prices lower and further eased recent inflation worries.
In the late New York session, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, held steady at 99.90.
After the Fed announced it would keep rates unchanged last week and offered an ambiguous outlook for future policy, the dollar index had already fallen 1.5%.
Following the confirmation that the United States and Japan were coordinating a yen‑market intervention, the dollar fell 0.3% against the yen to 157.18, briefly dipping to 155.23 intraday.
The euro slipped 0.2% against the dollar to $1.1508 per euro.

Markets also focused on the decline in oil prices, which helps reduce short‑term inflation pressure. This trend was reinforced by a weekend announcement from U.S. President Trump that the United States would begin talks with Iran on Strait of Hormuz shipping and denuclearisation, signalling a clear de‑escalation in the Middle East.

U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Sunday that the United States firmly supports Japan’s measures to correct the yen’s severe undervaluation and warned that the Treasury would not hesitate to join any further joint market‑intervention actions.

The intervention marks the first U.S.–Japan coordinated yen‑buying operation in decades. After the yen fell below 162 per dollar at the end of July – a 40‑year low – the two countries decided to step in.

The move also capped the volatile July for the yen. By the end of the month the yen had appreciated 1.6% against the dollar, its best monthly performance since October last year. Market intervention, together with hawkish signals from the Bank of Japan (BoJ), triggered a large short‑covering rally that pushed the yen higher.
Markets also absorbed the BoJ’s policy decision released last Friday. As expected, the central bank left its benchmark rate unchanged at 1.0%.

However, BoJ Governor Kazuo Ueda maintained a slightly hawkish stance, warning that high energy import costs could raise inflation risks and hinting that the bank remains ready to raise rates later this year.
Overall FX market direction continues to be shaped by developments in the Middle East. President Trump announced that U.S. and Iranian officials will resume direct talks on Monday.

Strategists at Bank of America Global Research noted that despite prevailing bearish sentiment on the yen – driven by continued outflows of Japanese capital and policy‑risk concerns under the Takaichi administration – the U.S.–Japan joint intervention is a significant turning point.

BofA believes the 155‑yen level could become a key “pivot point” in the FX market. The strategists point out that during earlier official interventions this year, the dollar/yen pair found strong support near 155, leading many to conclude that official actions have limited impact.

Nevertheless, if the exchange rate clearly breaks below 155, trading patterns may shift from “buy the dip in dollars” to “sell dollars on a rebound,” and corporate hedging‑driven dollar‑selling pressure could accelerate that shift.

Shusuke Yamada, BofA Securities FX and rates strategist, said, “U.S. participation in the coordinated intervention raises market expectations for a broader policy framework aimed at stabilising the yen.”

He added, “Because the United States is involved, the limitation of depleting foreign‑exchange reserves unilaterally is effectively removed, making it harder for speculative funds to oppose official actions.”

To mitigate any impact of dollar sales on the U.S. Treasury market, both Japan’s finance minister and Treasury Secretary Bessent said they would use the Fed’s Foreign and International Monetary Authorities (FIMA) repo facility to provide liquidity support.

BofA also noted that the joint intervention has heightened expectations that the BoJ will accelerate its rate‑hiking pace, moving a market‑expected 100‑basis‑point hike from October to possibly September.

Meanwhile, Trump confirmed that a previously planned military strike has been cancelled in favour of diplomatic negotiations to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, sending international crude prices down more than 4% and sharply cooling short‑term concerns that energy prices will drive inflation.

With the geopolitical‑risk premium easing slightly, the FX market will now turn its focus to a series of key U.S. economic releases due later this week, which will help gauge the Fed’s September rate‑policy direction. The most closely watched data are the upcoming labour‑market figures, with the July non‑farm payroll report serving as the headline release.

items.title: 日元反彈外溢亞幣！花旗、巴克萊齊發聲：韓元、新元與泰銖將受惠
items.title_en: Yen's Rebound to Benefit Asian Currencies, Says Citi and Barclays
paras: 美日聯合干預後日元急彈，亞洲貨幣跟漲行情獲華爾街點名，花旗與巴克莱最新客戶報告指出，因多數亞幣與日元走勢高度相關，「日元升值同樣會推動亞洲貨幣走強」，其中韓元、新加坡元、泰銖被列為最直接受惠者。
過去三個交易日裡，日元兌美元累計漲超 4%，脫離近 40 年低點，同期韓元、泰銖、菲律賓披索均升值至少 0.7%，不含日元的一籃子亞洲貨幣上漲 0.5%。
花旗駐新加坡策略師 Garg 與 Goh 在報告中指出，過去一年韓元、新元、新台幣與日元相關性最高，印度盧比與印尼盾最低。
巴克莱駐新加坡的 Kotecha 團隊也表示，韓元兌日元敏感度居亞洲前列，美日干預具協調性，外溢效果將大於歷史β值推算，首爾當局同步拋美元，韓元已升值至 9 個月新高，Fed 主席華許偏鴿導致美元回檔，也放大支撐力道。
不過，花旗與巴克莱均未把這視為趨勢反轉。根本錨點仍是美日利差。美國聯邦基金利率 3.5%–3.75%，日本僅 1%，差距 250–275 基點。
富蘭克林鄧普頓策略師提醒，干預只買時間、難替日本承擔政策代價；布魯金斯學者更直言，只要日債殖利率被人為壓住，日元仍被高估需下行。
中東能源風險、老齡化與產業空心化未解，加上美國這次賣歐元買日元，而非賣美元，讓市場對「聯手干預」成色存疑。
短線來看，日元帶動的亞洲貨幣修復可期；中長線匯率方向仍握在美日央行利差與套利交易手裡。
paras_en: Following the US-Japan joint intervention, the yen has rebounded sharply, and the trend of Asian currencies rising in tandem has been highlighted by Wall Street. According to the latest client reports from Citi and Barclays, since many Asian currencies are highly correlated with the yen, the appreciation of the yen will also drive the strengthening of Asian currencies. The Korean won, Singapore dollar, and Thai baht are expected to be the most direct beneficiaries.

Over the past three trading days, the yen has appreciated by more than 4% against the US dollar, moving away from its nearly 40-year low. During the same period, the Korean won, Thai baht, and Philippine peso have all risen by at least 0.7%, while a basket of Asian currencies excluding the yen has increased by 0.5%.

Citi strategists Garg and Goh stated in their report that over the past year, the Korean won, Singapore dollar, and New Taiwan dollar have had the highest correlation with the yen, while the Indian rupee and Indonesian rupiah have had the lowest correlation.

Barclays' team led by Kotecha in Singapore also noted that the Korean won has the highest sensitivity to the yen among Asian currencies. The coordinated US-Japan intervention will have a greater impact than historical beta calculations, and the Korean government's simultaneous sale of US dollars has driven the won to a nine-month high. The dovish stance of Fed Chairman Powell has also led to a decline in the US dollar, further supporting the won.

However, both Citi and Barclays do not view this as a trend reversal. The fundamental anchor remains the US-Japan interest rate differential, with the US federal funds rate at 3.5%-3.75% and Japan's rate at 1%, resulting in a difference of 250-275 basis points.

Franklin Templeton strategist warned that intervention only buys time and cannot replace the policy costs borne by Japan. A Brookings scholar stated that as long as Japan's bond yields are artificially suppressed, the yen is still overvalued and needs to decline. The unresolved issues of Middle East energy risks, aging population, and industrial hollowing, combined with the US selling euros to buy yen instead of selling US dollars, have raised doubts about the effectiveness of the joint intervention.

In the short term, the yen-led recovery of Asian currencies is expected. However, the medium- to long-term direction of exchange rates remains in the hands of the US-Japan central bank interest rate differential and arbitrage trading.

items.title: 川普還沒宣布關稅 逾百萬噸銅已瘋狂湧入美國
items.title_en: Trump Has Not Announced Tariffs Yet, Over a Million Tons of Copper Flooding Into the U.S.
paras: 外媒周一 (3 日) 報導，美國精煉銅進口量以至少 12 年來最快速度增加，交易商趕在美國總統川普決定是否對精煉銅加徵關稅前，持續將海外銅材運往美國，推動當地庫存升至歷史高點，卻也加劇其他地區的供應緊張。
IHS Markit 自 2014 年開始統計的航運數據顯示，約 20 萬噸精煉銅於 7 月運抵美國，創下單月最高紀錄。其中約 11.09 萬噸存放在美國港口，但尚未登記為倫敦金屬交易所 (LME) 可交割庫存。
美國大量吸收全球銅供應，導致境外 LME 倉庫庫存今年明顯下降。由於紐約商品交易所 (COMEX) 銅價持續高於 LME，交易商可以從中套利，因此將金屬轉運至美國市場。
7 月 COMEX 近月期銅與 LME 現貨價差平均超過每噸 350 美元，足以支付運輸等成本並吸引海外供應。COMEX 官方銅庫存今年已增加逾 40%，創下歷史新高；市場普遍估計，美國境內囤積的銅總量已遠超過 100 萬噸。
美國商務部長盧特尼克原定在 6 月 30 日前提出銅關稅建議，但期限過後仍未公布結果。白宮目前正評估，是否將對半成品銅與銅衍生品課徵的 50% 關稅，進一步擴大至精煉銅等原料。
支持者認為，關稅能鼓勵美國投資國內採礦與加工產業；反對者則警告，措施將提高依賴進口銅的製造商成本，削弱美國產品的競爭力。
川普去年 7 月指示盧特尼克研究，自 2027 年 1 月起對精煉銅進口分階段加徵關稅，初期稅率可能為 15%。如果白宮決定課稅，生效前可能再掀一波搶運潮；若放棄相關計畫，交易商則可能解除過去 18 個月累積的部位，使銅材流向逆轉。
在美國快速囤銅之際，倫敦市場已浮現供應吃緊跡象。LME 近月銅價較 3 個月期貨溢價約 65 美元，價差創 1 月以來最大。這種近月價格高於遠月的「逆價差」結構，通常反映短期供應緊張。
隨著銅在電網、AI、電動車與國防領域的重要性升高，關稅威脅意外協助美國建立戰略庫存，但也讓全球銅市場進一步分化。
paras_en: Foreign media reported on Monday (the 3rd) that U.S. imports of refined copper are increasing at the fastest pace in at least 12 years. Traders, racing to move overseas copper to the United States before President Trump decides whether to impose tariffs on refined copper, have pushed local inventories to historic highs, while also tightening supplies in other regions.

Shipping data compiled by IHS Markit since 2014 shows that about 200,000 tonnes of refined copper arrived in the United States in July, setting a single‑month record. Roughly 110,900 tonnes of that cargo are stored in U.S. ports but have not yet been registered as deliverable inventory on the London Metal Exchange (LME).

The massive U.S. absorption of global copper supplies has caused inventories in overseas LME warehouses to fall sharply this year. Because COMEX copper prices in New York remain consistently higher than LME prices, traders can arbitrage the spread and therefore reroute metal to the U.S. market.

In July the price gap between near‑month COMEX copper contracts and LME spot copper averaged more than $350 per tonne, enough to cover shipping and other costs and attract overseas supply. COMEX’s official copper stocks have risen by more than 40% this year, hitting a record high; market participants generally estimate that the total amount of copper stockpiled inside the United States now exceeds one million tonnes.

U.S. Commerce Secretary Gina Raimondo had originally planned to submit a copper‑tariff proposal by June 30, but no decision has been announced after the deadline passed. The White House is currently evaluating whether to extend the 50% tariff that applies to semi‑finished copper and copper derivatives to raw refined copper as well.

Proponents argue that a tariff would encourage domestic investment in mining and processing; opponents warn that the measure would raise costs for manufacturers that rely on imported copper and weaken the competitiveness of U.S. products.

In July last year, Trump instructed Raimondo to study a phased tariff on refined copper imports starting January 1 2027, with an initial rate that could be around 15%. If the White House decides to impose the tax, another wave of rush‑to‑ship activity could occur before it takes effect; if the plan is abandoned, traders may unwind positions built up over the past 18 months, reversing the flow of copper material.

While the United States is rapidly stockpiling copper, the London market is already showing signs of tightening supply. The near‑month LME copper price carries a premium of about $65 over the three‑month contract, the widest spread since January. This “backwardation” – where near‑month prices exceed farther‑out contracts – typically signals short‑term supply pressure.

As copper becomes increasingly important for power grids, AI, electric vehicles and defense, the tariff threat could unintentionally help the United States build a strategic reserve, but it also further fragments the global copper market.
